title: Deployment Strategist - SAP & ERP Specialist
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

title: Dexterous Hands Lead (Founding Team Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

You will build Vesoma’s hands development group from the ground up. Starting as its first member, you will define how our humanoids manipulate the world: what we buy, what we build, and how hand hardware and learning-based control come together on our platform.
In the near term you will get capable third-party hands running reliably on our robots so that development and deployment are never blocked. In parallel you will set the technical direction for our own dexterous hands, build the team that develops them, and take the first in-house generations from concept to robust, deployable hardware.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the hands engineering roadmap. Make and defend the build-versus-buy decisions, define the architecture for in-house hands, and plan the path from first prototypes to a product that holds up in real deployments.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire the first engineers across mechanical design, actuation, sensing and embedded electronics, and set up the processes, tooling and test infrastructure the group needs to move fast without cutting corners.

  • Drive the design of our own hands, including kinematics, actuation and transmission concepts, tactile and proprioceptive sensing, and the electrical and communication interfaces to our control and software stacks. Design for robustness, serviceability and manufacturability from the start.

  • Bridge the gap with external hardware. Evaluate the global ecosystem of robotic hands, select and manage suppliers, and lead the mechanical and electrical integration of third-party end-effectors until our own hardware takes over.

  • Establish validation as a core discipline. Develop test rigs, benchmarks and endurance protocols that measure precision, force, duty cycle, durability and real-world task performance, and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Work closely with our AI team so that hand hardware fits our learning-based approach, with attention to sensing quality, backdrivability, contact robustness and transfer from simulation to reality.

  • Bring safety into the design early, in line with the standards work our company helps shape.

Your profile

You have built dexterous or comparably complex mechatronic systems yourself and want the chance to do it again, this time with ownership of the whole effort. You combine deep hands-on engineering with the judgment to set direction and the drive to build a team around it.

Experience

  • 8+ years in robotics hardware, mechatronics or system integration, with significant hands-on work on robotic hands, grippers or other high-DoF manipulation systems.

  • A track record of taking hardware from concept through multiple prototype iterations to a working, tested system.

  • Experience leading engineers or technical workstreams, ideally including hiring and building a team.

Core skills

  • Strong understanding of actuation and transmission choices for compact, high-DoF systems (direct drive, tendon-driven, gear and linkage designs) and their tradeoffs in force, speed, backdrivability, efficiency and wear.

  • Experience with tactile and force sensing and how sensor data feeds into control and learning.

  • Mechanical design for small, dense, robust assemblies, including CAD, tolerancing, material choice and design for manufacturing and assembly.

  • Electrical and embedded fundamentals: motor drivers, sensor interfaces, communication buses, firmware integration.

  • Fundamental software skills, solid grasp of real-time control requirements.

  • Comfort with kinematics, linear algebra, coordinate systems and 3D transformations.

  • Willingness to get your hands dirty: rapid prototyping, wiring, soldering and assembly.

Mindset

  • You think like a builder and an owner. You make clear technical decisions under uncertainty, explain them well, and change course when the data says so.

  • You care about reliability above showcase demos. Hands that work consistently in the field matter more to you than hands that look impressive once.

  • You enjoy building something from zero: the hardware, the team and the way they work together.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Director Minerva Frontline (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the Minerva Frontline organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.

Your Mission

As Director Minerva Frontline, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program, taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines.
  • Lead, mentor, and empower three direct reports and scale the broader multi-disciplinary organization across Berlin and Munich in these teams.
  • Define and communicate a compelling product vision internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.
  • Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).
  • Drive seamless system interoperability, ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems .
  • Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.
  • Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO) over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.
  • Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.
  • Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.
  • Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.
  • Exceptional internal and external communication skills — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.
  • High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.
  • Willingness to travel regularly between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Nice-To-Have

  • Prior military service (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.
  • Fluency in German, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.
  • An established network within the European defence ecosystem, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.
  • Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS), military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

title: Director, Text-to-Speech Synthesis Research
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

What You'll Do

  • Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.

  • Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.

  • Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.

  • Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains why models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.

  • Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.

  • Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.

  • Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.

  • Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.

You Must Have

  • Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.

  • Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.

  • A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.

  • Experience leading researchers and research engineers through other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.

  • AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.

  • The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.

It'd Be Great If You Had

  • TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.

  • Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.

  • Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.

  • Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.

  • Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

title: EMI, HIRF, Lightning Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for an EMI/EMC, HIRF & Lightning Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and support electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic environmental effects activities for the Microliner aircraft.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day engineering activities related to EMI/EMC, High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF), and lightning protection throughout the aircraft development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture support through analysis, design integration, testing, verification, and certification. Working closely with colleagues from Systems, Propulsion, Airframe, Safety, Verification and Validation, and Certification, you will ensure that electromagnetic environmental effects are appropriately addressed at aircraft, system, equipment, and installation level.

As part of Central Engineering, you will act as an internal focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning engineering. Working within the established technical approach and with guidance from senior subject-matter expertise, you will independently drive engineering activities within your area, coordinate across disciplines and suppliers, resolve technical issues, and develop substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Develop and maintain aircraft-level EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning requirements within the established technical framework, supporting their decomposition, allocation, and verification across aircraft systems, equipment, installations, and structures.

  • Perform and coordinate EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning assessments, including interference sources, coupling paths, equipment susceptibility, installation effects, and direct and indirect lightning effects.

  • Develop, assess, and support the implementation of protection and mitigation measures, including shielding, grounding and bonding, filtering, cable routing and separation, equipment installation, and structural protection provisions.

  • Support the maturation of the aircraft EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning protection approach, evaluating technical solutions, identifying risks and trade-offs, and developing substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

  • Define and coordinate verification and qualification activities within the assigned scope, including analysis, inspection, equipment qualification, ground and aircraft testing, and testing performed by external laboratories.

  • Independently investigate and resolve electromagnetic interference and compatibility issues during equipment development, system integration, and testing, involving senior technical expertise where significant architectural or programme-level decisions are required.

  • Support safety, certification, and compliance activities, including preparation and review of assessments, qualification evidence, verification results, and compliance documentation in accordance with applicable standards.

  • Act as an internal technical focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning topics, coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists, while contributing to the continuous improvement of related engineering methods and processes.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a comparable technical discipline, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in EMI/EMC, HIRF, lightning protection, or related electromagnetic environmental effects.

  • Practical experience in EMI/EMC engineering, including emissions and susceptibility/immunity, grounding and bonding, shielding, filtering, cable installation, and electromagnetic coupling, combined with experience in HIRF and/or lightning protection.

  • Working knowledge of relevant aerospace standards and guidance, such as RTCA DO-160 / EUROCAE ED-14 and the SAE ARP541x series, with experience supporting related analysis, testing, or equipment qualification.

  • Good understanding of aircraft electrical and electronic systems and their integration; experience with high-voltage architectures, electric propulsion, power electronics, or composite aircraft structures is a strong plus.

  • Experience with civil aircraft development and certification under EASA CS-23/CS-25, FAA Part 23/25, or comparable frameworks is desirable; experience within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation is a plus.

  • Understanding of systems and safety engineering principles for safety-critical aircraft systems, preferably with exposure to SAE ARP4754 and ARP4761.

  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy within an established technical framework, while recognizing when technical issues require broader coordination, specialist input, or escalation.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong technical ownership and the ability to investigate complex electromagnetic interactions and translate findings into practical design recommendations.

  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Engineering Manager - Compute and Data Platform (AI Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Behind Wayve’s embodied AI is the compute and data infrastructure that enables our ML engineers and researchers to train and run increasingly capable models. Our Compute Foundations team builds and operates the large-scale cloud infrastructure that makes this possible, spanning GPU compute, storage, workload scheduling and the platforms that support training and inference.

You’ll lead this London-based team through its next phase of growth, helping build and maintain a reliable, high-performance, multi-cloud and multi-region platform. The challenges go beyond provisioning resources: they include scheduling workloads across different GPU architectures, keeping valuable compute available, and moving data efficiently while managing costs.

You’ll lead a team working with state-of-the-art tooling to tackle infrastructure challenges found only at the world’s leading AI companies, building the platform that enables Wayve to develop its AI Driver.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

People leadership will be your first priority. You’ll coach and develop engineers, set clear expectations, manage performance. You’ll build technical leadership within the team, giving engineers the support and ownership they need to grow. You will guide the growth of the team through hiring and onboarding.

Alongside this, you will own project prioritisation and roadmap planning, aligning priorities and delivery plans with stakeholders across Wayve. Your goal is to maximise the impact of the team in alignment with the department and company objectives. You will provide visibility into the state of systems you own through clear KPIs and dashboards.

Leading a highly technical team, you’ll bring the technical judgement to guide complex infrastructure decisions and turn competing needs into a clear roadmap. Working with technical leads, partner teams and cloud providers, you’ll balance reliability, performance, capacity and cost, and help the team deliver sustainably.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and developing the team: Coach engineers through regular feedback and one-to-ones, manage performance, support career development and build a healthy, performant and accountable team.

  • Hiring and building technical leadership: Lead hiring and onboarding as the team expands, and develop technical leads who can take ownership of key areas of the platform.

  • Driving the roadmap and delivery: Translate training and inference needs into priorities, align commitments with available resources, and surface risks and dependencies early.

  • Scaling cloud compute: Guide the evolution and operation of a multi-cloud, multi-region training and inference platform, including the adoption of new compute architectures (Nvidia Hopper, Blackwell; Qualcomm).

  • Improving scheduling and availability: Oversee Kubernetes-based infrastructure and queuing and scheduling systems, enabling workloads to use the right resources across heterogeneous GPU environments.

  • Planning capacity and cost: Partner with stakeholders and cloud providers on compute and storage forecasts, accounting for resource lead times, performance requirements and cost trade-offs.

  • Ensuring efficient storage across clouds: Guide distributed storage and caching approaches that improve data access and reduce unnecessary duplication and cross-cloud transfer costs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have a strong track record of managing and developing an infrastructure, platform or distributed systems engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.

  • You have delivered through others, owning team priorities and balancing delivery with operational reliability and longer-term platform improvements.

  • You have substantial experience in Kubernetes and workload queuing and scheduling systems, such as Kueue or equivalent technologies.

  • You can reason about availability, capacity, performance and cost across complex cloud infrastructure, including the interaction between compute, storage and data movement.

  • You understand large-scale GPU compute infrastructure for machine learning training or inference and the operational challenges of scaling beyond small GPU deployments.

  • You can earn engineers’ trust through sound technical judgement without needing to be the team’s primary individual contributor. You have successfully delivered as an individual contributor in the past.

  • You communicate clearly with technical teams, stakeholders and external providers, and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical priorities.

  • You are able to work from our London office and lead a team based there.

The following experience would be useful but is not required:

  • Operating multi-cloud or multi-region platforms for large-scale AI workloads.

  • Introducing new GPU architectures or managing heterogeneous GPU fleets.

  • Distributed storage, caching and data-locality strategies for data-intensive workloads.

  • Capacity forecasting, cloud cost modelling and close collaboration with cloud infrastructure providers.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews: system design and hiring manager interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: technical leadership, code review and people management

  • Final interview: leadership, mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. Deeploy gives them that control. We work with dozens of enterprise customers in finance, insurance and healthcare.

You’ll own deals from first outreach to signed contract, with a focus on the Netherlands and Northwest Europe. Most of our buyers have never bought AI governance before, so much of the work is helping them define the problem and build the internal case. You report to the COO, and the founders stay involved in deals.

What you’ll do

  • Deals: run enterprise deals from qualification to close. Deals typically take 6 to 12 months and involve risk, compliance, legal, IT and a business sponsor. The GRC (governance, risk and compliance) function is often the way in.

  • Pipeline: build a large part of your own pipeline through outbound, your network, our partners and events. Marketing runs campaigns with you.

  • Visibility: speak at events and roundtables for risk, compliance and AI governance audiences.

  • Feedback: bring back what buyers respond to, how they compare us with alternatives, and what they miss in the product.

  • Process: help set up how we qualify, forecast and run deals, and later how we onboard new sellers. We’re a small team that works with AI daily, so you’ll also build some of your own tools and agents.

After 12 months

  • You’ve closed at least 4 new enterprise accounts and built €1m+ of qualified pipeline.

  • AI Governance officers know Deeploy, and know you.

  • You have proven to yourself as part of our team, culture and processes.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve closed complex enterprise deals with long cycles and several stakeholders, ideally in financial services, insurance, pharma or life sciences.

  • You know how risk, compliance or IT buyers think, from selling GRC, security, data or AI software, or from working on the buyer side.

  • You have a network among these buyers in the Netherlands or elsewhere in Northwest Europe.

  • You can discuss the EU AI Act and how AI systems are built and monitored with some confidence. You don’t need to be an engineer.

  • You’ve worked at an early-stage company or founded one, and you’re comfortable building pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluent English. Dutch or German is a strong plus.

What the role is, and what it is not

It is a builder role. Deal ownership comes first, commercial process a close second.

It is not a lead-execution seat, and you don’t carry the number alone. The founders stay close to deals and are responsible for the commercial function.

What we offer

  • Competitive base and bonus

  • Share plan from day 1

  • Pension plan and other benefits

  • Hybrid working from The Stack in Amsterdam, home to around 40 AI startups

  • The chance to be part of an early stage startup, building the sales function and grow with it

Hiring process

  1. Application: your CV or LinkedIn, and something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

  2. Introductory call (30 minutes)

  3. Conversation with two people you’d work with closely (60 minutes)

  4. Case study (3 hours, timeboxed), presented to two team members

  5. Offer

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐

You may be a great fit at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

title: ERP Specialist
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an ERP Specialist to maintain, integrate and continuously improve our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environment. You will be the day-to-day owner of the system: you keep it running, connect it to the shop floor, and turn user requests into working, tested changes.

You will work directly with production, finance, procurement and quality. If a material is booked wrong or an order does not reach the line, you are the person who finds the root cause and fixes it.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Dynamics 365 F&O: configuration, security roles, master data, batch jobs and environment management.

  • Build and maintain integrations between Dynamics 365 F&O and the MES/PLC layer, logistics and purchasing partners, reporting tools and external systems.

  • Support production processes in the ERP: production orders, bills of materials, routings, batch and serial traceability, and inventory movements.

  • Develop and maintain extensions and reports (X++, data entities, Power BI) to close functional gaps.

  • Manage updates, quality updates and release testing together with IT and the ERP Lead.

  • Provide first- and second-level user support and training, and document processes and configurations.

  • Monitor data quality and integration health, and resolve incidents through root-cause analysis.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience administering or implementing Dynamics 365 F&O or a comparable ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics AX).

  • Working knowledge of at least two modules: production control, procurement, inventory, finance or project accounting.

  • Experience building or maintaining system integrations (REST/OData APIs, data import and export, middleware).

  • Structured problem-solving and strong documentation habits.

  • The ability to work independently and handle several user requests in parallel.

  • A degree in business informatics, computer science, industrial engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Desirable experience

  • X++ development experience and Dynamics 365 F&O certification.

  • Azure Integration Services or Power Platform.

  • SQL and data analysis.

  • PLC, SCADA or MES data integration.

  • Experience in regulated or hazardous-materials manufacturing.

  • Working proficiency in German.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: EW Network & Embedded Software Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will take our directional mesh datalink from the lab bench onto real platforms and make it a fieldable, manageable, and verifiable network. You own everything between the radio and the rest of the system: the embedded software stack, network management, data transport, and the logging that proves the link works. No RF background is required. We are looking for a strong embedded and networking engineer who has put software on physical systems.

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Integrate the datalink onto platform compute: embedded Linux bring-up, drivers, deployment images, OTA updates, and secure boot.
  • Build network management: node identity, configuration and key distribution, health monitoring, and remote diagnostics of fielded nodes.
  • Own automated logging as a deliverable in its own right: time-aligned at both ends of the link and detailed enough to serve as evidence for programme milestones.
  • Implement telemetry and video transport (UDP/TCP, RTP) and the interfaces to ground control stations and our C2 software.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Embedded Linux experience beyond the application level: bring-up, drivers, and product deployment.
  • Networking at packet level, including how UDP and TCP behave under loss.
  • You have integrated software onto a physical system (vehicle, robot, or aircraft) and you treat the log as a design object, not an afterthought.
  • C/C++, Python, and Yocto or a comparable build system.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with the PX4, ArduPilot, or MAVLink ecosystem, ideally from a UAS manufacturer.
  • Video transport over constrained or lossy links.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Expansion Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften.

Unsere Mission: Pflegeeinrichtungen und qualifizierte Fachkräfte schnell, fair und passgenau zusammenzubringen – mit digitalen Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren.

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Für das nächste Kapitel unserer Erfolgsgeschichte schlagen wir eine Brücke nach Westeuropa: Von unserem Headquarter in Berlin aus starten wir die Expansion in den französischen Markt. Dafür suchen wir empathische und umsetzungsstarke Talente im Customer Success, die den Beziehungsaufbau zu französischen Pflegekräften von Tag 1 an mitgestalten.

Aufgaben

  • Erstkontakt & Betreuung der ersten französischen Pflegehelden! – Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für französischsprachige Pflegekräfte, begleitest sie empathisch ab der ersten Kontaktaufnahme und führst sie erfolgreich durch den Vermittlungsprozess.
  • Prozessaufbau & Kandidaten-Betreuung im Zielmarkt! – Du nimmst die Wünsche der Pflegekräfte auf Französisch auf, gestaltest ihren Bewerbungsprozess unkompliziert und hilfst dabei, Candidate-Experience-Standards für den französischen Markt neu zu etablieren.
  • Passgenaue Stellenvermittlung für Frankreich! – Du bringst französische Talente und die ersten Partnerunternehmen zusammen, indem Du Qualifikationen und Wünsche präzise mit den Angeboten der Arbeitgeber matchst.
  • Feedbackschleifen für den Markteintritt nutzen! – Du sammelst aktiv Rückmeldungen von Kandidaten im neuen Markt, erkennst kulturelle oder prozessuale Besonderheiten und hilfst so, unser Angebot stetig an Frankreich anzupassen.
  • Enger Schulterschluss mit dem Berliner Sales-Team – Gemeinsam mit dem Key Account Management entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, um die Erwartungen der ersten französischen Kandidaten und Partnerunternehmen zu übertreffen.
  • Präzise Dokumentation & Datenpflege – Du pflegst alle Kandidatendaten auf Französisch in unseren Systemen ein und stellst sicher, dass die Kennzahlen für unsere Expansion jederzeit verlässlich sind.
  • Pionierarbeit im Candidate Success – Du schaffst von Berlin aus echte Win-Win-Situationen im neuen Zielmarkt und gestaltest die internationale Ausrichtung von Pflegia aktiv mit.

Qualifikation

  • C2-Sprachniveau in Französisch und C1-C2 Deutsch: Nachgewiesen durch Deinen Lebenslauf oder Zertifikate. Du betreust Kandidaten und Ansprechpartner auf Französisch und arbeitest eng mit dem Berliner Team auf Deutsch zusammen – absolute Sprach- und Verhandlungssicherheit auf beiden Sprachen ist zwingend.
  • Pioniergeist & Aufbaumentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Abläufe im Kundenservice für einen neuen Markt mitzugestalten und flexibel auf die Dynamik einer frühen Expansionsphase zu reagieren.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie – Du kannst komplexe Themen im Pflegebereich auf Französisch und Deutsch verständlich erklären und gehst stets wertschätzend auf Menschen zu.
  • Organisationsgeschick – Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen aus dem neuen Markt den Überblick und arbeitest hochstrukturiert.
  • Eigeninitiative und Lösungsorientierung – Du packst Hürden im Markteintritt proaktiv an und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen für kandidatenseitige Herausforderungen.
  • Digitale Affinität – Du fühlst Dich im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Slack und Zoom wohl und arbeitest gerne datenbasiert.

Benefits

  • Top ausgestattetes Office in Berlin – Ein modernes Büro mit zentraler Lage, erstklassiger Anbindung und inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung.
  • Attraktive Vergütung – Ein faires Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision, die Deinen Erfolg direkt belohnt.
  • Einfluss & Wachstum – Du bist maßgeblich an unserem Eintritt in den französischen Markt beteiligt und gestaltest diesen Meilenstein aktiv mit.
  • Unbegrenzte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Zeig, was in Dir steckt! Bei uns gibt es keine Limitationen – ob Du Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln, mehr Verantwortung übernehmen oder eine Führungsposition anstreben möchtest: Deine Karriere ist das, was Du daraus machst! Wir wachsen schnell und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.

title: Expansion manager France / Développeur.se Immobilier - Grand Est
descriptionHtml:
Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule !

  • Tu vis près de Lyon ou Strasbourg

  • Tu as +3 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseignes ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.

  • 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur.

  • Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail.

  • Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios.

  • Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée.

  • Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

  • Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ;

  • Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager

  • Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ;

title: Fachredakteur Steuerrecht (m/w/d) - Content & SEO
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Seit 16 Jahren betreuen wir als digitale Steuerkanzlei Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland, vor allem E-Commerce, vemögensverwaltende GmbH und KMU. Wir sprechen Steuerrecht genauso fließend wie Software und machen Steuerberatung mit eigenen Lösungen einfacher. Wir sind inhabergeführt, unabhängig und ohne Investoren. Unser Ziel: Deutschlands beste digitale Steuerkanzlei zu werden. Damit Unternehmer das auch verstehen, suchen wir dich.

Deine Vision bei uns

Wir wollen die Steuerkanzlei sein, der Unternehmer im Netz am meisten vertrauen. Nicht durch Werbung, sondern durch Inhalte, die wirklich helfen. Du baust diese Wissensplattform mit auf. Deine Texte werden zur ersten Anlaufstelle, wenn jemand eine Holding gründen, eine Trading GmbH verstehen oder seinen Jahresabschluss einordnen will.

Und danach? Eine Wissensplattform ist nie ganz fertig, aber wir haben schon viele Ideen, wie es weitergeht. Du wächst mit und gestaltest mit, welche Formate und Projekte als Nächstes kommen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neue Blogartikel nach SEO/GEO-Standards zu Steuerthemen schreiben (Keyword-Beispiele: holding gründen kosten, jahresabschluss bundesanzeiger, gmbh steuern)

  • Bestehende Blogartikel und Landingpages inhaltlich und sprachlich verbessern

  • Fachliche Texte für Landingpages: Leistungsbeschreibungen, FAQs, Rechenbeispiele

  • Skripte schreiben für YouTube-Videos und Social-Media-Clips

  • Fachliche Prüfung von Texten und Freigabe

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Manager (SEO, Themenplanung)

  • Texte mit Persönlichkeit: Du schreibst selbst und nicht per KI-Knopfdruck. Uns sind Texte wichtig, die menschlich klingen und Erfahrung zeigen.

So könnte deine Woche aussehen: Du schreibst zwei neue Blogartikel, überarbeitest ein YouTube-Skript eines Kollegen und optimierst Texte von drei bereits vorhandenen Landingpages.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsjurist (Schwerpunkt Steuerrecht) oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Texten, Content oder Blogs

  • Spaß am Schreiben und daran, Komplexes einfach zu erklären

  • Sicheres Deutsch: Du schreibst klar, verständlich und grundsätzlich fehlerfrei.

  • Selbstständiges Arbeiten: Du organisierst dich remote gut selbst und hältst Termine ein.

  • Neugier auf Steuerthemen: Du verfolgst Gesetzesänderungen und hast Lust, sie verständlich aufzubereiten.

Das bieten wir

  • Rahmenbedingungen, die passen: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Voll- oder Teilzeit ohne Kernarbeitszeit, High-Tech-Homeoffice-Setup, individuelle Arbeitszeitgestaltung und 30 Tage Urlaub ohne Urlaubssperre.

  • 100 % Homeoffice: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und bist trotzdem eng in die fachlichen und persönlichen Strukturen des Teams eingebunden, das sich gegenseitig stark unterstützt.

  • Kein Fristendruck, keine Buchhaltung, keine Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen

  • Sichtbarkeit: deine Texte und Videos erreichen tausende Unternehmer

  • Direkter Draht zu unseren Steuerberatern und Spezialisten für Trading, E-Commerce und GmbH, du bleibst fachlich am Puls.

  • Tolles Team: Du arbeitest mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die ihr Wissen gern teilen und sich gegenseitig unterstützen. Auch remote sind wir ein Team: Jedes Jahr gibt es ein Sommerfest, ein Winterfest und ein eigenes Event in Deinem Team.

title: Facilities Coordinator
descriptionHtml:

title: Factory Advisor (Deployed Factory Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

A factory network is only as good as its worst site. Factory Advisors, sometimes called deployed factory engineers, get new and existing sites in our network running to the Isembard standard and keep them there.

You will deploy into factories, work directly with owner-operators, general managers and site teams, and be their point of contact as they become operationally and financially successful. Technical competence matters, but communication is the differentiator: you learn the operating playbook in depth, teach it clearly and hold every site to it.

What you'll do

  • Support factory setup, onboarding and operating-model implementation at new and existing sites.

  • Translate the playbook into shop-floor practice: production flow, documentation, quality and traceability, communication cadence and MasonOS adoption.

  • Train site teams and explain technical concepts in language people can act on.

  • Audit factories against the playbook, write clear findings and corrective action plans, and recommend go or no-go when a site is not ready.

  • Help site owners understand their P&L and cash flow, and improve profitability.

What we're looking for

  • Strong operating experience in a demanding, practical environment.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication.

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to learn systems quickly.

  • The judgement to hold a high bar without losing the room.

  • The ability to analyse a P&L and cash flow statement.

Nice to have

  • Implementing SOPs, quality systems, training programmes or site audits.

  • Process engineering or factory operations.

  • Military operations or logistics.

  • Manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, and exposure to AS9100, ITAR or export control.

Why Isembard

  • Directly affect how well factories launch, operate and improve.

  • Work across advanced machine tools, MasonOS, quality systems and live production.

  • Strong operators earn more scope quickly.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our London or Dallas factory, with frequent travel across the UK and Europe or across the US, including extended site deployments.

title: First Line Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:

As a First Line Manager at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.


What you'll do

  • Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

  • Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

  • Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

  • Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

  • Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

  • Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.

  • You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

  • You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

  • Building a team excites you more than your own quota.


This might not be the right fit if…

  • you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

  • you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

  • you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

  • you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.


Why now

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.
