title: Forward Deployed Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About NearformNearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart. 

We're on a mission to reinvent how our clients work

Most companies are bolting AI onto old processes and hoping for the best. We think that's the wrong way round.

Nearform is on an exciting journey with AI, and we're building a new team to lead it. The team brings together two worlds that rarely meet: the business thinking of a strategy firm and the engineering depth of a company that builds and ships real products. That puts us in a small group of firms that can do both. We work out what should change and we build it.

The Role

Our clients don't all start in the same place. Some know something has to change but have no idea where to start. Others have a clear picture of the future and are ready to build. Most are somewhere in between.

Your job is to work out where each client really is and shape the right solution for them. That could mean helping a leadership team choose which process to tackle first. It could also mean turning a rough idea into something our engineers can build.

This isn't a traditional management consulting role

You won't be writing a strategy deck that sits on a shelf. This is  hands-on work, close to the technology, and focused on results you can see.

Primary Responsibilities:

  •  Get on the ground. Sit with the teams doing the work, whether they're checking customers against sanctions lists or pulling together month-end reports. Learn how it really happens, including the workarounds, the judgement calls and the steps nobody wrote down.
  • Spot the opportunity. Find where AI and automation can change the game, and where a person still needs to make the call.
  • Design what comes next. Work side by side with a forward deployed engineer to shape a better way of working, testing ideas against what can actually be built.
  • Prove the value. Own the business case for each process you redesign. Work out where the value is, put numbers on it, and set up how it will be measured, so that after go-live you can show the client what changed.
  • Make it real. Turn your design into a plan clear enough for our engineering teams to build, then see it go live.
  • Bring people with you. Run workshops, win over frontline staff and make the case to senior leaders.

Between clients, you'll help build what comes next:

  • Help win new work. Join early conversations with prospective clients and help shape proposals that show what's possible.
  • Shape our offer. Turn what you learn on projects into the methods, tools and stories that make the next engagement faster and sharper.
  • Make the team stronger. Share what works, test new ideas and help define how this team operates as it grows.

Experience:

  •  At least 10 years in consulting, business analysis, operations improvement or a similar role.
  • A track record of mapping a business process and redesigning it with real stakeholders.
  • Confidence in front of clients, whether you're running a workshop, interviewing frontline staff or presenting to a broad group of client stakeholders, including the C-suite.
  • Outcomes thinking. You start with the result the client needs, such as faster turnaround, lower cost or fewer errors, and work backwards from there. You judge success by what changes for the business, not by what gets delivered.
  • Commercial sharpness. You've built business cases before and can turn operational improvements into numbers a CFO will believe.
  • Storytelling. You can pull together a clear, compelling storyline for presentations, quarterly business reviews and leadership updates, the kind that gets decisions made.
  • Builder's mindset. You work in short cycles and test ideas quickly. You'll spin up a proof of concept with tools like Claude Cowork, Lovable or Replit to show a client what's possible, rather than waiting for a perfect plan.
  • A solid grasp of what AI and automation can and can't do. You don't need to code, but you'll hold your own with engineers.
  • Sharp writing: you turn messy conversations into a clear document others can act on.
  • Able to spend time on client sites.

Benefits

  • Competitive employee benefits package
  • Work flexibly; we appreciate there are more important things in life than work so our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • The Wellness Hub: We have a genuine commitment to fostering/improving NearFormers’ wellbeing; we offer resources and support, including a NearForm advice line which offers confidential support for anything from relationship issues to staying healthy.

Benefits

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
descriptionHtml:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
  • Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
  • Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
  • Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
  • Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.

We expect you to have:

  • A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
  • At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
  • A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
    • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
    • Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
    • Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

Our ideal candidate would have:

  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.
  • Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.
  • The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
  • A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
  • Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.
  • A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

title: Fullstack Developer .NET
descriptionHtml:
Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan alleen het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur.

Als Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt aan zowel de frontend als backend van OrtaX, bouwt nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd de bestaande applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren.

1. Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX.Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteit in C#/.NET;

  • ontwikkelen van moderne gebruikersinterfaces en webfunctionaliteit;

  • werken aan frontendfunctionaliteit met met één van de grote frontend frameworks;

  • ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's en integraties;

  • werken met databases en data-intensieve functionaliteit;

  • schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code;

  • bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps;

  • oplossen van technische vraagstukken die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden;

  • meedenken over architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX.

Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.

2. De technische uitdaging

OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Binnen het ontwikkelproces worden onder andere Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, pipelines, testing, SonarQube en Oracle gebruikt. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen bezig bent met: “Hoe bouw ik deze feature?” maar ook met vragen als: “Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat wat we vandaag bouwen ook past bij waar we technisch naartoe willen?” Voor een developer die graag verder kijkt dan alleen zijn of haar eigen user story is hier dus veel te doen.

Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer.

3. Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken vooral een developer die nieuwsgierig is en zich prettig voelt aan meerdere kanten van de applicatie. Je:

  • hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • hebt ervaring met C# en .NET;

  • hebt ervaring met, of interesse in, moderne frontendontwikkeling;

  • hebt bij voorkeur gewerkt met één van de grote frontend frameworks;

  • begrijpt principes rondom API's, databases en softwarearchitectuur;

  • schrijft graag code die niet alleen werkt, maar ook begrijpelijk en onderhoudbaar is;

  • bent gewend om samen te werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving;

  • denkt analytisch en vindt het leuk om complexe problemen terug te brengen tot een pragmatische oplossing;

  • durft bestaande oplossingen ter discussie te stellen, maar begrijpt ook dat software stap voor stap moet kunnen veranderen;

  • communiceert makkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel expert te zijn. We vinden het belangrijker dat je technisch sterk bent, graag leert en bereid bent je zowel aan de frontend- als backendkant verder te ontwikkelen.

4. Waarom OrtaX?

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij wordt geïnvesteerd in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie.

Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt.

Je krijgt dus de combinatie van een volwassen product én de technische veranderopgave die normaal gesproken vooral bij een nieuw product hoort.

5. Wat bieden we jou?

Het salaris ligt tussen € 4700,- en € 5500,- per maand (daarnaast ontvang je een variabele beloning, vaste 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je rol, competentieprofiel en ervaring.  Verder bieden we je uitstekende voorwaarden, waaronder: 

  • deelname aan een goede pensioenregeling 

  • 27 vakantiedagen (gebaseerd op een fulltime contract) 

  • mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen 

  • Hybride werken vanuit huis en het kantoor in Amsterdam (uiteraard ben je welkom om elke dag op kantoor te werken) 

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor je dagelijkse woon-werkverkeer en evt. zakelijke reizen 

  • mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een trainingsprogramma en wekelijkse onderzoeks- en kennisbijeenkomsten 

  • je start met een jaarcontract, daarna is er uitzicht op een vast contract, omdat we streven naar een langdurige samenwerking 

  • een prettige werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega's! 

6. Over OrtaX

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. De ambitie is om taxateurs te ondersteunen met slimme automatisering en tegelijk te investeren in nieuwe technologie, procesautomatisering en integratie.

Daarbij werken we niet alleen aan wat OrtaX vandaag nodig heeft, maar ook aan hoe het product er technisch morgen uit moet zien.

Wil jij daar als Fullstack Developer aan meebouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Gap-Year-Student (m/w/d) im Office der Geschäftsführung
descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben

Eigene Projekte mit echter Verantwortung: Du übernimmst über die Monate hinweg mehrere klar abgegrenzte Initiativen, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

KI-Anwendungen bauen: Du nutzt KI nicht nur als Tool, sondern entwickelst eigene Anwendungen für unser Team und unsere Kunden, von Automatisierungen über Custom GPTs bis zu kleinen Webanwendungen.

Strategische Mitarbeit: Du arbeitest an OKR-Planungen, Investorenpräsentationen, Marktanalysen und Operational-Excellence-Themen mit.

Cross-funktionale Einblicke: Du bekommst Zugang zu allen Bereichen (Tech, Fulfillment, Marketing, Sales) und verstehst nach einem Jahr, wie ein wachsendes Unternehmen wirklich funktioniert.

Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du wirst behandelt wie ein vollwertiges Teammitglied, mit allen Rechten und Pflichten.

Ihr Profil

Du hast Dein Abitur mit sehr guten Leistungen abgeschlossen oder befindest Dich zwischen Bachelor und Master.

Du bringst hohe intrinsische Motivation mit und Lust, ein Jahr lang wirklich etwas zu lernen statt es einfach zu überbrücken.

Echte Begeisterung für KI und Technologie: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor & Co., probierst Neues aus und schreckst nicht zurück, wenn ein Projekt technisches Neuland ist.

Keine Angst vor technischen Herausforderungen: Wenn ein Workflow automatisiert werden muss oder ein neues Tool evaluiert werden soll, legst Du los und lernst beim Tun.

Analytisches Denkvermögen, Hands-on-Mentalität und unternehmerisches Gespür.

Reife, Eigenverantwortung und Lust, schnell zu lernen, auch wenn vieles neu ist.

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Warum wir?

Unser Ziel: ein faires, datengetriebenes Wertgutachten für jede Immobilie in Deutschland. Bei Certa ersetzen wir das klassische Sachverständigenwesen durch eine KI-gestützte Bewertungsplattform, die schneller, präziser und transparenter ist als alles, was der Markt heute kennt.

Du planst ein Gap Year zwischen Schule und Studium oder zwischen Bachelor und Master und willst diese Zeit nicht mit Backpacking-Klischees, sondern mit echter Verantwortung füllen? Bei Certa bekommst Du eine Rolle, die Du in einem Jahr nirgendwo sonst bekommst.

Das Office der Geschäftsführung arbeitet direkt mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern (Alexander Rausch & Matthias Mertens) an den Top-Themen, die Certa als Unternehmen entscheidend voranbringen. Vom OKR-Framework über Marktexpansion und Operational Excellence bis zum Aufbau skalierbarer Backoffice-Strukturen. Trotz der Nähe zur Geschäftsführung leben wir eine entrepreneuriale, pragmatische Arbeitskultur: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, hohe Umsetzungstiefe.

Ein Gap Year bei Certa ist kein Praktikum mit Abstrichen, sondern eine vollwertige Rolle mit eigenen Verantwortungsbereichen. Du bekommst Zeit, in mehrere Themen tief reinzukommen, eigene Projekte aufzubauen und mit der Zeit echte Ownership zu übernehmen.

Ein Jahr, das Dich prägt: Du lernst in 12 Monaten mehr über Wirtschaft, Technologie und Unternehmensführung als in den ersten zwei Studienjahren.

Direkte Linie zu den Gründern: Du arbeitest täglich mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern. Keine Layer, keine Politik, keine Slide-Schlachten.

Spielwiese für KI-Enthusiasten: Bei uns ist KI kein Buzzword, sondern Arbeitsalltag. Du bekommst Zugang zu allen relevanten Tools und Modellen.

Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an Themen, die wirklich zählen, nicht an Beschäftigungstherapie.

Faire Vergütung: Anders als bei vielen Gap-Year-Programmen wirst Du bei uns als vollwertiges Teammitglied bezahlt.

Perspektive über das Gap Year hinaus: Werkstudentenstelle während des Studiums, langfristige Mentorship und ein klarer Einstiegspfad nach dem Abschluss.

title: Generalist, Fellowships
descriptionHtml:
You make sure each fellowship cohort runs smoothly, from acceptance to the last day, so that fellows and Research Managers can focus on research.

  • Salary: £68,250–£95,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you might own

There are many areas worth owning at Pivotal that shape how good and productive a fellow’s time with us is. In 2027 we expect about 170 fellows across our fellowships, often with multiple cohorts on site at the same time. You help each of them have an excellent experience.

Which areas you own depends on your strengths and interests. It might be the systems behind each cohort, our events, how we collect and act on fellow feedback, and sometimes new areas will arise. You’ll likely work on several projects and areas at the same time, and these will change as Pivotal grows.

  • Fellow logistics. Onboarding, travel, letters for visas, desks and equipment, and stipend payments with our finance provider.

  • Events. Socials, speaker events, retreats and closing weeks, including the room and AV setup.

  • Fellow experience. Collect feedback during each cohort and fix problems quickly.

  • Records and tools. Keep fellow records and fellowship tools up to date, and automate work that repeats every cohort.

  • Other cohort needs. Take on whatever the cohort needs, with good judgement about what matters most.

Who does well in this role

  • You are organised and reliable: things you own get done, and people know their status.

  • You have run events or operations for a program, a team or an organisation.

  • You understand why a task matters, and you suggest better ways to do it.

  • You are friendly and calm with fellows, also under pressure.

  • You use AI tools to automate repetitive work.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £68,250 – £95,500

title: Global People & Culture Director
descriptionHtml:
Strategic Mandate

The Global People Director will be a key architect of Cambridge Consultants’ transformation to inspire and lead a new era of deep tech innovation. They will be the strategic bridge between Capgemini (our parent company) and CC. They will steer the cultural, talent, and organisational transformations to enable the company to:

  • Build an entrepreneurial, innovation‑driven culture where teams embrace calculated risk, experimentation, and rapid learning.
  • Shape an AI‑native organisation, equipping all employees with the mindset and fluency to leverage the latest AI tools.
  • Create a diverse leadership pipeline and talent engine that strengthens innovation, client partnership, and global reach.
  • Operationalise the cultural and behavioural expectations of our strategy through hiring, development, reward, leadership capabilities, and organisational design.

About the Role

You will act as a strategic partner to the executive team and senior leadership, linking the people agenda to our strategy. Driving transformational change in our People & Culture, to build a diverse talent engine tuned to innovation & partnership.


At the core of this role is shaping an entrepreneurial culture where people run toward bold innovation challenges - and build a diverse, high-performing talent engine that enables it. You’ll lead the Global People function, set direction for HR Business Partnering, Talent, L&D, EDI, and People Operations, and ensure integrated delivery across the employee lifecycle. You’ll be a critical partner to the executive, offering courageous challenge and clear thinking to align decisions with company goals.

Work pattern: Hybrid – role holder expected in office frequently & some international travel
Reports to: CHRO, Capgemini Invent with dotted line to Cambridge Consultants CEO
Direct Reports: 4 – HR Business Partnering, HR Ops, L&D, Recruitment

Key Responsibilities

1) Strategic Partnership & Organisational Leadership

  • Lead the Global People Team, managing the Heads of Functions to deliver the Global People Strategy
  • Partner with the executive team and senior leaders to translate business strategy into clear, outcome-based people plans that accelerate growth and innovation.
  • Shape the Executive Leadership Team as a cohesive team - improving decision quality, collaboration, and strategic alignment.
  • Lead org design and workforce planning (structure, capability, location strategy) for present and future needs in a global matrixed environment.

2) Culture, Engagement & Internal Communications

  • Champion a more entrepreneurial, experimentation-driven culture; reinforce psychological safety, ownership, and speed of learning.
  • Build and sustain high employee engagement; craft compelling narratives and communications that bring strategy to life.
  • Embed established feedback loops (listening strategy, pulse surveys) and turn insights into visible action.
  • Champion organisational simplification to improve pace, autonomy, and agility.

3) Talent Strategy & Leadership Development

  • Lead the development of a future skills blueprint, incl. deep tech, commercial partnering, and AI-native capabilities.
  • Build a diverse talent engine across succession and mobility; ensure equitable access to opportunities globally.
  • Lead performance and career development frameworks that enable growth, accountability, and retention.
  • Oversee design of leadership development pathways and manager capability uplift to scale consistent, inclusive leadership behaviours across regions.

4) EDI / Inclusive Futures

  • Own the EDI strategy (policy, governance, targets and reporting) aligned to local regulations and global best practice, to increase representation of diverse talent at senior and technical leadership levels with measurable targets.
  • Embed inclusive hiring and progression

5) Change & Transformation

  • Lead end-to-end change and transformation programs (org design, process reengineering) to become an AI-native, innovation-centric, client partnership organisation, whilst ensuring business continuity and employee experience.
  • Establish change methodologies, leader readiness, and change success metrics; coach leaders to role model change.
  • Continuous improvement of the Global People Team and strategy – building capabilities and optimising process

6) Employer Brand & Marketing Partnership

  • Strengthen our Employer Value Proposition (EVP) to position CC as the global destination for exceptional deep tech and innovation talent and ensure its authentically reflected in the employee experience.
  • Partner with Marketing to elevate employer branding

7) People Analytics & Decision Support

  • Leverage HR analytics to diagnose business health (engagement, attrition, performance, diversity), forecast workforce needs, and inform decisions.
  • Build a data-driven culture within HR; improving people systems and data capture 

8) HR Solutions Delivery & Governance

  • Ensure integrated delivery across Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, People Operations, L&D, Reward, and EDI.
  • Maintain high standards of compliance (employment law, data privacy), operational excellence, and scalable HR processes suitable for global growth.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience

  • Substantial HR leadership experience with a proven track record operating at Director level (or equivalent) in a global, matrixed organisation.
  • Demonstrated success in strategic people leadership, culture building, and enterprise-level transformation.
  • Experience leading cultural transformation in a technology, innovation, or consulting environment.
  • Prior success in building AInative or data-driven organisations is strongly preferred.
  • Proven delivery across talent management, performance, engagement, org design, and EDI.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strategic operator who links people plans to business outcomes
  • Change leadership: design and deliver change; coach leaders through ambiguity
  • Understand innovation culture, and high-performance technical teams
  • Influence & challenge: a critical partner driving alignment of senior leaders; courageous, commercially grounded, and solutions oriented.
  • EVP: partner with Marketing to position Cambridge Consultants as a destination for diverse, innovative talent
  • Inspirational people leader who unites and elevates a people function
  • Deep commitment to inclusion, equity, and belonging; credible on modern EDI practices and reporting.

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

title: Graduate AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance as AI Transformation Leads. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate AI Transformation Lead, you’ll work on client teams from your first month, alongside experienced AI Transformation Leads and AI engineers, with real responsibility from day one. You’ll analyse how a business works, where time and money go, and where AI fundamentally changes the economics. You’ll build the models, business cases and story a leadership team will act on, and prototype new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar. You’ll work side by side with engineers to define what gets built, test it with the people who will use it, and help the client’s teams adopt it. As one of our first graduate cohort, you’ll also help shape our graduate programme and how Resonance trains and grows.

Your first year: Structured training in AI, consulting and the industries we work in, with coaching from Senior AI Transformation Leads and the founding team. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job. You’ll start as a Junior Transformation Lead and typically move up a level within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. You’re finishing an undergraduate or master’s degree in a technical subject, such as engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or another natural science, or a quantitative subject such as economics, or you graduated in one in the last two years, with top results from a top university. You structure problems clearly and are comfortable with numbers. You use AI every day and have built something with it, whether a project, a tool or an automation, and you’re curious about how businesses actually work. You can show you make things happen through internships, a society you led, a company you started or something you built. An internship in consulting, banking, private equity or a startup is a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Real client work from your first month, learning from people who have shipped 30+ AI products and embedded AI into 50+ businesses. Every engagement ends with AI running in production and results you can measure. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and a chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades and a short note on something you've analysed or built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter:innen für unser Social-Media bzw. Designteam, die die komplette grafische Umsetzung unserer Recruiting- und Marketingprojekte übernehmen und damit maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Kunden beitragen. Wenn du strukturiert arbeitest, ein gutes Auge für Design hast und visuelle Inhalte erstellen kannst, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auch performen, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wer wir sind:
DIGIHEADS gehört zu den etablierten Agenturen im Bereich Recruiting-, Employer-Branding- und Neukundenstrategien. Als Wachstumspartner für den deutschen Mittelstand entwickeln wir Social-Media-Kampagnen, Aufbau- und Optimierungsprozesse sowie automatisierte Systeme, die unseren Kunden helfen, planbar neue Mitarbeiter und Neukunden zu gewinnen.

Mit einem starken, prozessorientierten Team unterstützen wir Unternehmen deutschlandweit und suchen Kolleginnen & Kollegen, die in einem stabilen, strukturierten Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen möchten. Wenn du bereit bist, Projekte präzise zu steuern, Kundenbeziehungen aktiv zu stärken und mit einer klaren Hands-on-Mentalität zum Wachstum von DIGIHEADS beizutragen, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

Bisher haben wir über 210 Partner betreut und gehören damit deutschlandweit zu einer der führenden Agenturen in diesem Bereich. In der Zusammenarbeit konnten unsere Partner bereits über 930 Einstellungen verzeichnen. Zu unseren Partnern zählen namhafte Unternehmen und Organisationen wie alle Standorte der Bäckerei Grobe, alle akzenta-Standorte sowie Vanderlande, DSW21, verschiedene Standorte der Diakonie und des DRK sowie Meyer Recycling.

Deine Rolle – kreativ, performanceorientiert & verlässlich

Als Grafikdesigner (m/w/d) bist du verantwortlich für die komplette grafische Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung (nach gründlicher Einarbeitung) für:

  • Die Planung und Gestaltung von Creatives (Bilder, Grafiken, Animationen, kurze Videos, Carousel-Formate) für Meta-Werbeanzeigen (Facebook & Instagram)

  • Gestaltung von Karriereseiten & Landingpages über Perspective und Onepage

  • Gestaltung und Planung von Social-Media-Beiträgen für uns selbst oder unsere Kunden (Layouts, Grids, Feed-Gestaltung und Upload)

  • Gestaltung von internen Marketingmaterialien (Reports, Präsentationen, Collagen, Visuals, Grafiken)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektmanagement sowie Foto-/Videografen.

  • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten visuellen Markenqualität inkl. strukturierter Dokumentation und Ablage.

Kurz gesagt:
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alles Visuelle und verwandelst Strategien in performante Designs.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Canva und/oder der Adobe Creative Cloud (insb. Photoshop)

  • Erste Erfahrung im Grafikdesign oder in der Erstellung digitaler Inhalte

title: Growth Development Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest operative und strategische Initiativen im Bereich Offline Growth und entwickelst sie End-to-End konsequent weiter.

  • Du arbeitest proaktiv, hands-on, lösungsorientiert und sehr eng mit dem Managementteam zusammen und stehst deiner/deinem MentorIn bei strategischen Entscheidungen zur Seite.

  • Du identifizierst neue Projekte im Bereich Offline Growth, überlegst Dir eigenständige Strategien und setzt diese kundenorientiert, sowie unternehmerisch um.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän intern wie extern mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen und sorgst für klare Abstimmung, schnelle Entscheidungen und saubere Umsetzung.

  • Du übernimmst ad-hoc Projekte in verschiedenen Bereichen und unterstützt das Growth Team in all seinen Aufgabenfeldern.

  • Du bist ein integraler Teil unseres Growth Teams und arbeitest übergreifend mit Sales, Tech, Brand an Enpals zukünftiges Wachstum.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über erste Arbeitserfahrung oder Praktika in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting

  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus

  • Du besitzt eine natürliche Stärke in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Ausgeprägtes, Verhandlungsgeschick und einen natürlichen "Closer"-Spirit

  • Du hast großes Interesse am Aufbau von Unternehmen und einen ausgeprägten Willen Neues zu lernen

  • Du hast eine zielstrebige Arbeitsweise, ein hohes Maß an Proaktivität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Du besitzt Erfahrung im Priorisieren von Aufgaben in einem fast-paced Environment und kannst einen 100%-Ansatz beim Arbeiten an wichtigen Aufgaben umsetzen

  • Du denkst groß, liebst Geschwindigkeit, probierst unkonventionelle Ansätze aus – und bist bereit, echte Verantwortung für ein hochstrategisches Wachstumsfeld zu übernehmen.

  • Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an Dich selbst und andere und legst eine Can-Do-Mentalität an den Tag die andere motiviert

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit -Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

 

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

descriptionHtml:
About Reedsy

We’re here to give authors the tools and resources they need to create beautiful books. Our marketplace gathers the industry's best publishing professionals — the likes of Neil Gaiman's editor, Nora Roberts' book marketer, and GRRM’s cover designer.

We’ve grown to a community of 5,000,000 authors, and transformed the way people write and publish their book. Want to hop on board and help us get to our next destination? Cool, keep reading!

Responsibilities

We’ve built an app called Studio that allows writers to develop their worlds and characters, improve their craft, and share their story with the world as a print or digital book. It’s unique and already used by tens of thousands each day. Your role is to grow the number of monthly active users into the millions, and turn Studio into the most essential app for authors. You’ll tap into new audiences, convert existing Reedsy users to Studio, and spread the word about why Studio is the best tool out there for writing and editing books.

You will:

  • Define objectives for growth with Reedsy’s management;

  • Leverage Reedsy’s existing ecosystem by implementing referral campaigns and driving user advocacy;

  • Grow our top of funnel through a network of affiliates and influencers, as well as partnerships with brands and publications;

  • Work with our content team to create engaging content for social media and organize events;

  • Tap into new audiences and try unproven community growth strategies.

Requirements

This role is for a creative and analytical marketer with significant experience in building communities. Here’s what we look for:

  • 5+ years of proven experience in growth or product marketing at a fast-paced startup;

  • Knowledge of the craft of writing through personal experience or studies;

  • Experience writing branded content (social and emails);

  • Experience in mobile video creation and editing; and

  • Strong ability to collect, analyze and report on performance data.

Bonus points

  • You’ve developed your own creative project (a book, a blog, a product — anything!);

  • Fluent in multiple languages. Reedsy welcomes applicants of all cultures and backgrounds; and

  • A good dose of ambition, a willingness to learn, and a great sense of humor.

Benefits

  • Work from home;

  • Paid paternal and maternal leave;

  • Annual team retreat

Salary range:

€40k – €60k

title: Growth Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Fyxer

Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

 

We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.

You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.


The Role

You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.

  

What you will own:

You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.

  • Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

  • Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

  • Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

  • Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

  

Who You Are

  • Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

  • Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

  • Engineering partner: You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

  • Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

 

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage..

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.


#LI-FYX

title: Growth Strategy & Ad Monetization Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games and consumer apps.

 

Role

We are looking for a Growth Strategy & Monetization Manager to join the Ad Monetization team. You will work directly on revenue-critical topics, combining strategic thinking, data-driven analysis, and operational execution to improve performance across millions of daily users. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting or analytical background who wants to move from advising to owning a € multi-hundred-million revenue engine.

  • Drive revenue Performance

    • Own ad monetization performance across a portfolio of games and apps

    • Analyze revenue drivers such as ARPDAU, fill rate, eCPM, LTV, and ad engagement

    • Identify structural improvement levers across waterfall configuration, in-app bidding, pricing strategy, and demand diversification

    • Translate analysis into concrete action plans with measurable revenue impact

  • Optimize the ad tech stack

    • Work closely with engineering to improve mediation setup, experimentation frameworks, and auction dynamics

    • Structure and lead A/B tests to maximize yield and long-term LTV

    • Evaluate and integrate new ad networks, bidding partners, and ad monetization formats

    • Anticipate ecosystem shifts in privacy, platform policies, and auction mechanics

  • Lead high-impact projects

    • Structure ambiguous ad monetization challenges and break them into actionable workstreams

    • Coordinate with product, UA, data, and creative teams to align ad monetization with user experience and growth strategy

    • Build scalable processes and dashboards to professionalize performance tracking

    • Contribute to long-term ad monetization strategy and revenue diversification initiatives

  • Act as a business owner

    • Operate with full visibility on revenue performance

    • Take ownership of initiatives end-to-end, from diagnosis to implementation

    • Influence key decisions impacting millions in annual revenue

 

Profile

  • Master’s degree from a top engineering or business school (Programme Grande Ecole).

  • You have 3-6 years of experience in a fast-paced environment (start-up, strategy consulting, investment banking, etc.)

  • You are curious, highly analytical, and passionate about having an impact, whatever’s thrown your way

  • You wish to work in an environment that values candor, freedom, and responsibility

  • Nice to have:

    • You can run your own SQL queries

    • You have experience in gaming or performance marketing

  • You are fluent in English and French

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Flexible vacation policy

title: Head of Account Management (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Client Impact at Upvest owns our clients' journey from signature to go-live and beyond, spanning Launch, Migrations, Account Management, Client Experience and Integration Success. Once a client is live, Account Management takes over: we own the relationship end to end, grow it commercially, run it strategically and make sure our clients see Upvest as a partner, not a vendor. Client satisfaction is one of the things that sets us apart from incumbents, and recommendations from our live clients have already been key to new wins.

We are looking for a Head of Account Management to lead this team and Upvest's live client portfolio, which includes some of Europe's best-known fintechs, neobrokers and banks. You will own the commercial development of the portfolio (renewals, upsell, ARR and revenue retention) and the senior relationships behind it, lead a team of senior Account Managers, and build the operating model that lets us scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will sit across the table from client C-levels yourself, not only manage the people who do.

You will report directly to Jens Maluck, VP Client Impact, and work closely with Growth, Product, Launch, Client Experience and Finance.

What you’ll do:

  • Commercial growth

    • Own the commercial development of the live client portfolio: renewals, expansions and upsells, against budget and upsell targets

    • Spot commercial opportunities and leveraging knowledge across the portfolio

    • Lead commercial negotiations for live clients, including pricing

    • Build strategic account plans that set out each client's growth path with Upvest, from new use cases and asset classes to new functionality and geographies

    • Advise clients on their end-user investment offering (product, pricing, promotions, conversion), because the better our clients perform, the better Upvest performs

    • Provide case studies and references that help win new business

  • Client ownership

    • Be the senior counterpart for client leadership teams, from handover after go-live through renewals and escalations

    • Lead QBRs, Steering Committees and executive alignment, keeping stakeholders aligned from C-level to technical teams

    • Act as the filter between our clients and the wider Upvest organisation: answer most product, asset class and commercial questions directly, run client meetings independently with your team, and bring in others only where they add real value

    • Be the first point of escalation for live clients, resolving issues quickly and coordinating the wider organisation where needed

    • Represent the voice of the client inside Upvest, channelling structured feedback to Product, Operations and Growth

    • Safeguard the partnership by ensuring contract adherence on both sides

  • Performance and insight

    • Own the portfolio KPIs: ARR, net and gross revenue retention, and client satisfaction (CSAT and Account Health Score)

    • Track client performance (users, conversions, assets under custody, trading activity) against plan, and use anonymised benchmarks to help clients improve

    • Own the client input to the annual budget and the monthly actuals vs budget review with Finance

    • Report to senior management on account health, risks and opportunities, with clear actionable recommendations

  • Team and operating model

    • Lead, hire and develop a team of senior Account Managers, setting a high bar for quality, execution speed and commercial impact

    • Define and continuously improve how Upvest manages its live clients: account tiering, governance cadences, account health scoring, documentation and tooling

    • Drive AI adoption across Account Management, using Claude and system integrations to automate analysis, reporting and preparation work

    • Work very closely with Client Experience who own the day to day operational alignment and ticket resolution

What you bring:

  • Experience: 8+ years in account management, client success or strategic relationship management for B2B enterprise clients, of which 3+ years leading an account management or client team

  • Investment and brokerage expertise: You can discuss asset types in depth (equities, ETFs, funds and MMFs, bonds, securitised derivatives, crypto) and the trading, custody, settlement and fee economics behind them. Ideally, you gained this in B2B investment infrastructure or B2C brokerage (e.g. a neobroker or the investment offering of a digital bank)

  • Commercial track record: You have owned renewals, upsells and negotiations end to end, ideally against NRR / GRR targets or a commission plan, and you can name the deals you generated

  • Relevant background: Regulated fintech or banking with financial institutions as clients, or B2B API, embedded finance or enterprise SaaS

  • Product mindset: You are eager to understand the product in depth and E2E, and have a drive to represent it to the client without the Product team present. You understand the value of standardisation and automation over customisation

  • People leadership: You have led a team of senior individual contributors, and you can show both a strong team culture and raising the bar (coaching, performance management, stepping in when output falls short)

  • Operating model builder: You have built playbooks, improved processes and implemented systems that let a team scale

  • Data-driven: You run accounts on KPIs (client performance, forecast vs actuals, adoption etc.)

  • AI-enabled: You use AI hands-on every day (ideally Claude), are comfortable connecting it to business systems via MCP or similar, and can walk us through workflows you automated

  • Executive presence: You are a trusted counterpart for C-level stakeholders and lead QBRs, SteerCos and difficult commercial conversations without senior back-up

  • Ownership: You are the go-to person for your area: you communicate proactively, flag risks early and take a clear position. You are hands-on and not looking for a pure manage-the-managers role

It’s great if you have:

  • B2C brokerage experience, to guide clients on product design, pricing, promotions, conversion and activity

  • Experience with country expansion (local market specifics, tax and regulatory set-up, market launch)

  • A network and market insight in Upvest's core European markets (e.g. Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK, France)

  • Experience with migrations or large client transitions

  • German and/or Spanish language skills

  • Location preference: Berlin-based preferred. Alternatively London-based or remote, willingness to travel to Berlin every couple of weeks

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
