title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Dabei vereinen wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein wirksames Compliance- und Risikomanagement schafft die Grundlage dafür, dass unser Unternehmen innerhalb klarer regulatorischer und risikobezogener Grenzen handelt. Als Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement verantwortest du beide Funktionen in der zweiten Verteidigungslinie der Bank. Du stellst sicher, dass die relevanten gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen eingehalten werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Bereich identifizierst, bewertest, steuerst und überwachst du sämtliche Risiken. Dabei sicherst du die jederzeitige Risikotragfähigkeit und sorgst dafür, dass Risiken bewusst, angemessen und innerhalb der vom Management festgelegten Grenzen eingegangen werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bereichs „Compliance & Risikomanagement“ einschließlich der zugeordneten Beauftragtenfunktionen (z. B., WpHG-Compliance-, Beauftragter Regulatory Compliance, CISO, Risikocontrolling- und Auslagerungsbeauftragter)

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Compliance-Funktion: Sicherstellung einer wirksamen Überwachung der Einhaltung wesentlicher gesetzlicher und aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen

  • Etablierung bzw. Weiterentwicklung von Compliance-Standards und Richtlinien sowie Überwachung deren Einhaltung

  • Sicherstellung geeigneter Schlüsselkontrollen auf Basis risikoorientierter Überwachungspläne

  • Compliance-Risikomanagement mit Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Etablierung einer risikobewussten Unternehmenskultur („Compliance-Kultur“) mit entsprechenden Schulungen

  • Laufende Weiterentwicklung der Risikostrategie in Abstimmung mit dem Management

  • Laufendes Risikocontrolling von der Risikoinventur über die Entwicklung geeigneter Messmethoden bis zum laufenden Monitoring inkl. Stresstests

  • Überwachung der Risikotragfähigkeit

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Verantwortung der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen des GENO Broker und der DZ BANK AG, der Internen Revision, Wirtschaftsprüfern und dem Leitungsorgan

  • Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung einer angemessenen Risikokultur

  • Auslagerungs- und Drittparteien-Management (TPRM): Überwachung regulatorischer Anforderungen bei Dienstleistern und Kooperationspartnern

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die interne Meldestelle/Whistleblowing nach HinschG

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 5–7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Risikomanagement, in der Compliance-Abteilung einer Bank, in der Internen Revision oder bei einer bankennahen Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft gesammelt.

  • Du hast einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, rechtswissenschaftlichen oder wirtschaftsmathematischen Studienabschluss, idealerweise nach klassischer Bankausbildung.

  • Du verfügst über Zusatzqualifikationen/Zertifikate wie Certified Compliance Officer, Abschlüsse der genossenschaftlichen Akademien (z. B. GenoAkademie oder ADG) sowie im Bereich Geldwäsche/Anti-Financial-Crime (AFC) und über nachweisbare, tiefe Kenntnisse der Bankenregulierung (insb. KWG, WpHG, GwG, EBA-Leitlinien, BaFin-Rundschreiben zu MaComp).

  • Du hast technisches Verständnis und Kenntnisse im IKT-/IT-Risikomanagement (insb. DORA-Anforderungen) sowie im Auslagerungsmanagement.

  • Du bringst neben Führungserfahrung auch Durchsetzungsstärke, Diplomatie in der Gesprächsführung (mündlich und schriftlich) sowie analytische Exzellenz mit und bist in der Lage, hochkomplexe Gesetzestexte und Zahlenwerke schnell zu durchdringen und praxisnah in Handlungsempfehlungen und Managementvorlagen zu übersetzen.

  • Du arbeitest weisungsfrei und unabhängig, ohne jegliche Form von Interessenkonflikten.

Ein sicheres Auftreten, vor allem Souveränität im Umgang mit Wirtschaftsprüfern, dem Genossenschaftsverband und Prüfern der Aufsichtsbehörden, rundet Dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs, Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

descriptionHtml:

Tax at Midnite isn't a back-office function. We operate in one of the most heavily taxed and regulated industries, and we're expanding into new markets fast. As Head of Tax, you'll own Midnite's tax strategy and set-up across the UK&I, Gibraltar, Malta, South Africa and Canada, plus whatever comes next. You'll report directly to our founders.

You'll make the big structural calls on new markets, joint ventures, IP and fundraising. You'll keep a complex set of tax obligations running smoothly. And you'll turn constant tax change into clear decisions the business can act on. It's hands-on, high-ownership and genuinely strategic.

  • Experience of iGaming or gambling duties is a big plus.

At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
descriptionHtml:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

  • wiring sensors

  • mounting compute boards

  • setting up flight controllers

  • testing drones outdoors

  • fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.


What you’ll do

  • Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

  • Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

  • Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

  • Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

  • 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

  • Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

  • Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

title: Intervenant(e) en prévention des risques professionnels (IPRP)
descriptionHtml:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Nous recrutons un(e) IPRP (Intervenant(e) en Prévention des Risques Professionnels) pour renforcer l’équipe pluridisciplinaire de Prévenir, un SPSTI innovant qui accompagne environ 14 000 travailleurs en Île-de-France. Le poste est rattaché à notre centre (117 quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris) avec une activité mixte terrain (Actions en Milieu de Travail) et à distance (visio, webinaires).

Votre mission : contribuer à un objectif exclusif de prévention et de préservation de la santé et de la sécurité au travail, en accompagnant nos entreprises adhérentes sur l’évaluation, la hiérarchisation et la réduction des risques professionnels.

🧭 Parmi vos responsabilités

  • Réaliser des Actions en Milieu de Travail (AMT) : visites/observations en entreprise, études de postes, recueil d’informations (activité, effectifs, organisation, postes, procédés, produits, équipements, expositions, AT/MP, etc.).

  • Produire et mettre à jour des fiches d’entreprise et contribuer aux démarches d’évaluation des risques (DUERP, plans de prévention, registres SST, etc.).

  • Repérer, analyser et hiérarchiser les risques : physiques, chimiques, biologiques, ergonomiques, psychosociaux, organisationnels (TMS, chutes, bruit, vibrations, manutention, incendie/explosion, coactivité, risque routier…).

  • Formuler des recommandations de prévention en privilégiant la logique : supprimer → substituer → protections collectives → organisation.

  • Aider à construire et prioriser un plan d’actions réaliste (court/moyen terme) adapté aux moyens de l’entreprise, puis en suivre la mise en œuvre (indicateurs, amélioration continue).

  • Conduire des sensibilisations et formations (sécurité, thématiques prévention).

  • Participer aux CSE et contribuer à des enquêtes suite à accidents (selon besoins).

  • Contribuer aux actions collectives du SPSTI : campagnes de prévention, ateliers, webinaires, retours d’expérience.

  • Orienter vers des ressources externes si nécessaire (CARSAT/CRAMIF, INRS, ANACT/ARACT, inspection du travail, organismes de contrôle, consultants spécialisés), en lien avec le SPSTI.

Vous interviendrez dans une approche proactive : identification des entreprises à risque, propositions d’actions ciblées, et recherche d’impact mesurable.

👤 Le profil recherché

  • Enregistrement IPRP (DREETS) / certification par organisme agréé (uniquement si vous êtes à votre compte).

  • 3 à 7 ans d’expérience en prévention des risques professionnels (ou expérience équivalente fortement appréciée).

  • Domaines de compétence appréciés : ergonomie, psychologie du travail, hygiène industrielle, conseil en prévention/HSE.

  • Capacité à réaliser des fiches d’entreprise, évaluations des risques, études de postes (et éventuellement analyses/mesures selon votre périmètre).

  • Aisance dans le conseil et la restitution auprès d’employeurs et, selon les cas, des représentants du personnel.

  • À l’aise avec un fonctionnement hybride (terrain + distanciel) et les outils numériques.

  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler en coordination avec médecins du travail, IDEST, psychologues du travail, assistantes sociales, ergonomes, ASST.

  • Basé(e) en Île-de-France.

Vous vous retrouvez dans ces lignes ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature et nous échangerons avec plaisir.

title: Java Developer (Regular to Senior) | Backend-focused Full Stack (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!
At Accurids, we're building the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our system identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely and with better patient outcomes.
At Accurids, you'll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one.
As a member of our Product Development team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps and product owners. You will work directly with cross-functional engineering stakeholders, and the features and fixes you deliver reach our customers. Our CTO is directly available to you as a mentor and technical sparring partner.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Own features end-to-end, backend first: Design and build services, APIs (GraphQL and REST) and the data layer in modern Java and Spring Boot, then take the feature all the way into our React/TypeScript frontend. AI agents write most of the UI code, so your eye for good interfaces is what makes the difference.
  • Extend the platform: Build integrations with the systems our pharma customers rely on and extend the platform for customer-specific needs.
  • Bring AI into the product: Work on AI features inside the platform, from integrations with AI assistants to LLM-powered capabilities.
  • Amplify velocity with AI: Be part of our AI-native engineering culture. You use tools like Cursor, Claude or Gemini to speed up scaffolding, refactoring and test writing, while keeping architectural integrity, security and quality in view. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your role moves up a level. You direct them, help shape the architecture and own the quality of what ships.
  • Contribute to the architecture, hands-on: Help develop our modular architecture (Spring Modulith, platform and feature modules), optimize PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries and work with RDF semantic data structures.
  • Raise the bar on quality: Maintain solid test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright) and give thoughtful merge request reviews, including on AI-generated code.

What helps you succeed:

  • Backend experience: 3+ years building backend services in production. Solid knowledge of modern Java (21+) and Spring Boot (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), PostgreSQL with Flyway and API design with REST and GraphQL. A Computer Science degree, Fachinformatiker training or strong hands-on experience as a career changer are all welcome.
  • Eye for good UI: You have a feel for good UI principles and are happy to own the frontend part of a feature. Experience with React and TypeScript is a plus.
  • Architectural thinking: You think in modules, boundaries and trade-offs, and you enjoy building what you design.
  • AI-native mindset: AI tools like Cursor, Claude and Gemini are part of your daily workflow. You treat AI as an output amplifier and combine curiosity with sound judgment about what ships.
  • Quality & delivery: Experience with testing at all levels (unit, integration, E2E) and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Location & work permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit.
  • Languages: Business-fluent English is required, and German skills are a strong plus.
  • Bonus: DevOps experience (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS), semantic web (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Elasticsearch, LLM or MCP integration, Material UI, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP).

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Grow your expertise: Deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features or platform architecture as we scale.
  • Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required, and fully remote work is not offered.)
  • Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space.
  • Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €60,000 to €100,000 per year, depending on experience, for a full-time, permanent position.
  • Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card.
  • Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn't always follow a checklist, and we care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn.
At Accurids, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science and data to apply.

title: Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market
descriptionHtml:

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn.

Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

What can you expect from Securance?

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist

Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrolling, Kodierfachkräften und Ärzt:innen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Einen Produktbereich verantworten: Du übernimmst einen eigenen Bereich unseres Produkts, von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz in der Klinik.

  • Vor Ort beobachten: Du bist regelmäßig in Kliniken, schaust Kodierteams und Medizincontrolling über die Schulter und findest heraus, wo Zeit und Erlöse verloren gehen.

  • Anforderungen schreiben: Du übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene Fragen, bevor sie die Entwicklung aufhalten.

  • Regeln ins Produkt bringen: Mit unseren Fachexpert:innen sorgst Du dafür, dass Kodier- und Abrechnungsregeln richtig im Produkt ankommen.

  • Unsere KI besser machen: Du arbeitest mit Engineering an Evaluationen und prüfst, ob die Vorschläge von Valova mit jedem Release besser werden.

  • Releases begleiten: Du testest neue Versionen und begleitest mit Customer Success den Start in neuen Kliniken.

  • Mit Daten arbeiten: Du verfolgst, wie Valova genutzt wird und wirkt, und leitest daraus ab, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Medizinischer Hintergrund: Idealerweise ein Medizinstudium, eine Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf oder Erfahrung im Medizincontrolling. Du weißt, wie ein Fall durchs Krankenhaus läuft.

  • Erste Produkterfahrung: Ein bis zwei Jahre im Produktmanagement, in einem Health-Tech-Startup oder in der Beratung. Du hast schon einmal ein Feature oder Projekt von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht programmieren, kannst aber technische Dokumentation lesen und mit Engineers über Lösungen diskutieren.

  • Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, Medizincontrolling und Technik gleichermaßen sicher.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gern rund 20 bis 30 Prozent Deiner Zeit in Kliniken unterwegs.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch fließend auf C1-Niveau und gutes Englisch.

  • Ein Plus: Kenntnisse in Kodierung oder Abrechnung (z. B. DRG, OPS, GOÄ), Erfahrung mit KIS-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Tools wie Jira und Figma sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen.

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab der ersten Woche. Du übernimmst echte Projekte mit klarem Ergebnis und deinem Namen darauf, keine Aufgabenliste, die sich jemand anderes ausgedacht hat.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Startup-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths bedeuten null Verwaltungsaufwand, und die zentrale Lage bedeutet kurze Wege, schnellen Zugang zu Kunden und Investoren und Mittagsoptionen an jeder Ecke.

  • Ein motiviertes Team. , mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Engineers und Operators, die sich hohe Ziele setzen und sich gegenseitig dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen du feierst.

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das deinen Impact widerspiegelt.

So sieht Erfolg aus

  • Nach 3 Monaten kennst Du Valova in- und auswendig, hast in mehreren Kliniken Kodierteams bei der Arbeit begleitet und Deine ersten Features live gebracht.

  • Nach 6 Monaten verantwortest Du einen eigenen Produktbereich, und Kodierteams wissen, dass sie sich an Dich wenden können.

  • Nach 12 Monaten zeigt Dein Bereich messbare Wirkung im Klinikalltag, und Kodierteams verlassen sich täglich darauf.

  • Die ganze Zeit über kommt Feedback aus den Kliniken schnell in unserem Produkt an, weil Du regelmäßig vor Ort bist.

Bewerbungsprozess

Lade einfach Deinen Lebenslauf mit Deiner Bewerbung hoch. Für die nächsten Schritte melden wir uns bei Dir:

  • Kennenlernen (30 Min.): Wir lernen uns kennen, sprechen über Deinen Werdegang und beantworten Deine ersten Fragen.

  • Gespräch mit Malte (Produkt Lead) (60 Min.): Wir sprechen über Deinen Hintergrund und darüber, wie Du an Produktfragen herangehst.

  • Case: Du bekommst eine echte Situation aus dem Klinikalltag und zeigst uns, wie Du das Problem eingrenzt, priorisierst und in erste Anforderungen übersetzt.

  • Referenzen: Wir sprechen mit zwei oder drei Personen, mit denen Du zusammengearbeitet hast, zum Beispiel ehemaligen Vorgesetzten oder Kolleg:innen.

  • Team treffen: Du verbringst Zeit mit uns vor Ort in München, lernst unsere Gründer:innen Sophia und Christian kennen und siehst, wie wir im Alltag arbeiten.

  • Angebot: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hörst Du schnell von uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Retention Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen: Invisible Brands GmbH
Erfahrungslevel: Senior

Du betreust keine Accounts. Du entwickelst erfolgreiche Brands weiter.

Stell dir vor, du übernimmst die Verantwortung für eine ambitionierte E-Commerce-Brand.

Du analysierst ihre Zahlen, erkennst ungenutzte Umsatzpotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Strategien, die wirklich etwas bewegen.

Und das Beste daran? Du hast diese Entwicklung maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Genau so verstehen wir Key Account Management bei Invisible Brands.

Wir suchen keine reinen Projektverwalter, sondern Menschen, die strategisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und für ihre Kunden zu echten Wachstumspartnern werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Invisible Brands, eine spezialisierte Agentur für E-Mail- und Retention-Marketing aus Paderborn.

Wir helfen ambitionierten E-Commerce-Brands dabei, durch strategisches E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Marketing nachhaltig zu wachsen.

Dafür verbinden wir datengetriebene Strategien mit kreativem Storytelling, hochwertigem Design und technologischem Know-how.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen Brands wie Braineffect, Gillie, Fairment, Dermalogica, Bär Schuhe, Cusb Clothing, YoungFashionMind und Aylashes.

Unser internationales Team wächst weiter. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, unternehmerisch denken und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase gestalten möchten.

Deine Aufgaben – Strategie trifft Verantwortung

  • Key Account Management: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kundenportfolio, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner auf Entscheiderebene und entwickelst langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Retention-Strategie: Du entwickelst individuelle E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Strategien, um Umsatz, Wiederkaufraten und Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Performance & Reporting: Du analysierst relevante KPIs, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und präsentierst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen in regelmäßigen Strategie- und Performance-Calls.

  • Projekt- & Teamsteuerung: Du koordinierst unsere Copywriter, Designer und technischen Spezialisten und stellst sicher, dass Strategien effizient und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden.

  • Kampagnen & Automationen: Du verantwortest die strategische Planung von Kampagnen, automatisierten Flows, Produktlaunches und saisonalen Aktionen.

  • Kundenentwicklung & Retention: Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen und Abwanderungsrisiken, entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen langfristig aus.

Das Besondere: Du bist nicht für das operative Tagesgeschäft verantwortlich. Dir steht ein spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam zur Seite, sodass du dich auf Strategie, Kundenentwicklung und Performance konzentrieren kannst.

Dein Profil – Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, CRM, E-Commerce oder Account-Management gesammelt, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld.

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verstehst Retention-Marketing, Customer Journeys, Segmentierung und Marketing-Automationen und kannst daraus wirkungsvolle Strategien entwickeln.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du bist mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren CRM-Plattformen vertraut und verstehst die grundlegenden Zusammenhänge hinter erfolgreichen Set-ups.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du kannst E-Commerce-KPIs interpretieren, Potenziale erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du trittst souverän auf, kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären und kommunizierst mit Geschäftsführern und Marketingverantwortlichen auf Augenhöhe.

  • Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst unternehmerisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo CDP, A/B-Testing, Kundenbindungsstrategien oder der fachlichen Führung kleiner Teams.

Ein Studium oder eine bestimmte Ausbildung ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Uns interessiert, was du kannst und welche Verantwortung du übernehmen möchtest.

Was dich bei Invisible Brands erwartet

  • Modernes Office: Ein hochwertiges Arbeitsumfeld mitten in Paderborn.

  • Bekannte E-Commerce-Brands: Übernimm strategische Verantwortung für spannende Marken und anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte.

  • Eigenes Kundenportfolio: Du erhältst echte Entscheidungsfreiheit und gestaltest die Entwicklung deiner Accounts aktiv mit.

  • Spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam: Copywriting, Design und technische Implementierung werden durch erfahrene Kollegen unterstützt.

  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite mit Experten aus E-Commerce, CRM und Retention-Marketing zusammen und entwickle deine strategischen Fähigkeiten weiter.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Fitnessstudio-Zuschuss: Wir unterstützen deinen sportlichen Ausgleich.

  • Monatlicher Sachbezug: Nach deiner Probezeit erhältst du eine Sachbezugskarte mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Möglichkeit auf Unternehmensanteile (ESOP) nach zwijähriger Firmenzugehörigkeit

  • Firmenwagen: Je nach Position und individueller Vereinbarung besteht die Möglichkeit auf einen Firmenwagen.

Unsere Kultur – Ownership statt Dienst nach Vorschrift

Wir glauben an datenbasierte Entscheidungen, unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Bei uns zählt nicht, wer am lautesten spricht, sondern wer Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse liefert.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen, Lösungen entwickeln und nicht darauf warten, dass ihnen jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt.

Menschen, die ihre Kunden verstehen, ihre Zahlen kennen und den Anspruch haben, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Du musst nicht auf jede Frage sofort eine Antwort haben. Aber du solltest den Ehrgeiz besitzen, die beste Lösung zu finden.

title: Lab Technician
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company.


Key responsibilities

  • Run routine tests and measurements across both Bristol labs, following established procedures

Requirements

Desirable

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.

title: Lead Product Engineer | 36labs
descriptionHtml:
Role: Lead Product Engineer

Company: 36 Labs

Location: London, on site four days a week. The office is on Baker Street and moves to Primrose Hill within a couple of months. London-based candidates only.

Job Type: Full-time

About 36 Labs

36 Labs is an applied AI research firm in London. It is working on a gap in today's models: they are weak at creative decisions and at explaining why a decision was made. The team's thesis is that if you solve creativity in LLMs, you have largely solved what captures human attention.

The product is a harness that sits over any frontier model, especially video generation models. It runs ideation, generation and distribution end to end. Content goes out to real audiences, and a data loop improves the harness over time.

The company is profitable and works with Sony, Warner and Universal through bespoke marketing partnerships. Marketing is the proof of concept, not the destination. A B2C offering is due very soon. V3 of the harness is being released internally, and it is a big scope of work.

The team is ten people, with four engineers working under a CTO who is still hands-on in the code. The seed round closes in the next couple of weeks. This is a new stage of growth, not a replacement hire.

What you are expected to do:

  • Own the upcoming B2C product end to end, from launch: an AI-native, customer-facing product where UX matters as much as the models behind it.

  • Lead product engineering: make product calls with the founders, set the bar for how things get shipped, and help shape the team as it grows.

  • Work across the stack on the harness and the products around it. The structure is flat, so engineers work on a bit of everything, depending on what is needed.

  • Help build and ship on top of V3 of the harness as it moves from internal release into wider use.

  • Take ownership of your pieces of work and move them forward with little hand-holding.

  • Work closely with the CTO and the other engineers, and explain your ideas back to the team.

What you need to succeed:

  • You have four or more years of hands-on engineering experience, including in the AI-native era.

  • You have owned something before, and you can point to it.

  • You take the lead. You see what needs doing and start, without waiting to be told.

  • You communicate well. You explain your thinking clearly and enjoy discussing it.

  • You live in London and are happy to be in the office four days a week.

  • You do not need visa sponsorship at this stage. The company cannot sponsor until about February next year. A visa that runs well past February is fine.

  • You work with Python, TypeScript and Postgres, and you know LLM and generative model APIs and open-weight models.

  • You build and run back-end systems in production, including deployment and operation. This is a strong plus.

  • You keep up with the latest stacks, models and engineering practices, and you have side projects beyond your degree or day job.

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, maths, stats or similar is a plus, and so is an MSc or PhD. The university matters little, and experience matters more.

  • Experience in applied generative media or creative companies, such as Fal, is a plus. What you have built matters more than who you built it for.

  • A notice period of one month is fine.

What you get:

  • A seed-stage company with a profitable track record since it began operating.

  • A strong CV line, and the chance to learn a lot quickly.

  • Clear room to grow into a more senior role. The long-term plan is for the CTO to move to strategy and the bigger picture.

  • Work on a problem few companies are tackling, with an extremely high ceiling.

  • Real clients from day one, including Sony, Warner and Universal.

  • A small, flat team of ten, with direct access to the CTO and the founders.

How to apply

Send your LinkedIn profile or CV to Alexander at the agency. We start with a short screening call. After that, the process runs as follows. First, a first-round interview with Benedict, head of operations, covering your projects, CV and motivation. Second, a technical interview with the CTO of about half an hour. Third, a take-home technical assessment. If the team cannot decide between candidates, there may be a final onsite round where you work on something in front of the team. Strong candidates may go straight to the CTO.

title: Location Data engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

title: Manager CTO Office
descriptionHtml:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.
