title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
descriptionHtml:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung.

  • SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird.

  • LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand.

  • Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert.

  • Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements.

  • Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen.

Dein Profil

  • 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist.

  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen.

  • Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst.

  • Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt.

  • Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Deine Benefits

  • Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen

  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

  • Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag – zum Beispiel ein LinkedIn-Post zu einem regulatorischen Thema –, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns!

title: Mechanical Engineer - Antenna Positioning & Ground Equipment
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The challenge

We build the ground equipment that keeps our interceptor drones connected, and it must be set up fast by a single operator in harsh field conditions. Mechanics decide whether antennas stay on target and whether electronics survive transport, weather and rough handling. You will go from CAD to prototypes to field tests, working hands-on with RF, electrical and operations colleagues.

Missions

  • Design an antenna positioning system: drive train, cable management, stiffness and wind resistance.

  • Design rugged enclosures for radio modules and electronics: sealing, thermal management, mounting.

  • Evaluate off-the-shelf solutions: compare commercial positioners and mounts against our needs and support buy-vs-build decisions.

  • Build modularity into the ground equipment: common interfaces, quick set-up, easy maintenance.

  • Take parts from prototype to production: 3D printing to machined parts, drawings, mechanical BOM, assembly instructions.

  • Support field trials and deployments: set-up, feedback from operators, design fixes.

Required skills

  • Engineering degree in mechanical or mechatronics engineering, with experience designing electromechanical products.

  • Solid mechanism design fundamentals: tolerancing, gears and reductions, bearings, structural and wind-load calculations.

  • CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks), design for manufacturing and assembly, rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC).

  • Rugged outdoor design (sealing, thermal, vibration); experience with antenna trackers, gimbals, drones or defense equipment is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of motion systems (motors, encoders, drives) to collaborate with electrical and software teams.

  • Hands-on and autonomous, available for frequent field trials and travel.

title: Mixed-signal Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Experience with AMS (analog-mixed-signal) co-simulation flow, and setting up mixed-signal testbenches.

  • Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology.

  • Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

Nice to have

  • Verification experience with complex high-speed interface IP such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, UCIe, SerDes, USB, CXL, or similar PHY-based interfaces.

  • Experience verifying interface initialization, link training, calibration, adaptation, clocking, power-state transitions, or other digital/analog control loops.

  • Experience with real-number modeling, SystemVerilog RNM, wreal, Verilog-AMS, or equivalent mixed-signal verification techniques.

  • Experience developing or integrating behavioral models of analog/PHY components into digital verification environments.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: ML Data & Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an ML Data & Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure that powers our speech AI models: the pipelines that source and prepare training data, and the platform that trains, evaluates, and serves them in production. Speech AI has a data problem most ML teams don't, and you'll be at the centre of solving it, working as part of our ML team to remove friction across the entire lifecycle and get better models into production faster.

This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.

What you'll do

  • Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and storing large datasets used to train our models
  • Developing and maintaining web scraping and data acquisition solutions to keep training datasets fresh, high-quality, and available at scale
  • Building and operating the infrastructure that lets the ML team deploy and evaluate new models quickly, and that serves models efficiently and reliably in production
  • Optimising infrastructure for both iteration speed and production reliability, including GPU utilisation, job scheduling, and training efficiency
  • Implementing observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) across data pipelines and ML systems to catch issues early and keep things running smoothly
  • Troubleshooting complex issues across distributed systems, spanning data infrastructure, training, and inference
  • Continuously improving our data and MLOps practices, and helping shape the roadmap for how our platform evolves as we scale

What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with a solid backend or data engineering foundation
  • Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and working with a major cloud provider
  • Experience building data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes at scale, including web scraping or automated data collection
  • A solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data through to model training, evaluation, and serving
  • Experience with data quality practices (validation, cleaning, normalisation) and/or production-grade observability
  • Ability to design resilient, scalable architectures, and comfort operating and troubleshooting distributed systems
  • MLOps experience, for example model serving, experiment tracking, GPU/distributed training optimisation, or reproducible ML workflows
  • A self-starter mentality: comfortable identifying problems and driving fixes without needing detailed direction

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What we can offer you:

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there. 

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

title: Paid Working Student: Medical Device Design and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Piomic

Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. Our team of biologists, engineers and designers combines high-quality medical research with a close focus on the people who use our devices. Our vision: life shouldn't be defined by a medical condition.

What you'll do

  • Develop and evaluate concepts for the packaging, fixation and accessories of a medical device

  • Design geometry variants in CAD and produce them including additive manufacturing

  • Build functional prototypes and demonstrators and test them for handling and fit

  • Help develop a test setup that recognizes single-use components, from requirements to a working demonstration

  • Document designs, tests and decisions so they can feed into regulated product development

What you bring

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in industrial design, product design, mechanical/medical engineering or a related field

  • Hands-on skills in CAD and prototyping, including 3D printing

  • An independent, structured way of working and careful documentation

  • English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience with plastics, silicone or injection-molded parts

  • Basic electronics or embedded programming, for example microcontrollers or RFID/NFC

  • Interest in regulated products such as medical devices

  • You like to tinker and build things that work

What we offer

  • ownership from day one: your designs become working prototypes that go into testing

  • Hands-on impact on a breakthrough therapy for one of the deadliest conditions in healthcare

  • First-hand experience of how medical devices are developed under European and US regulatory requirements

  • A paid position with competitive pay

  • Hybrid work and a modern open workspace directly at the Zurich HB

  • Flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams

How to apply

• Your CV

• A short cover letter, one page at most, on which of the topics above interest you most

• A few examples or references of your design or prototyping work, if you have them

• Your university, program and how many hours per week you can work during the semester

title: Paralegal / Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee.

What you'll do

Drive legal engineering and process improvement

  • Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support.

  • Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations.

  • Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review and approval processes.

  • Test workflows, gather feedback, document how they work and iterate to improve their quality and adoption.

  • Build appropriate controls into processes, including lawyer review points, escalation paths and safeguards for confidential information.

Get directly involved in commercial legal work

  • Draft, review and prepare redlines for a wide range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, vendor contracts and partnership agreements.

  • Support negotiation and deal execution with Sales, GTM and other teams, including participating in discussions when appropriate and under lawyer supervision.

  • Help identify legal, privacy, data protection, security and AI-related issues in commercial matters, and bring them to the right lawyer for review.

  • Conduct legal research, prepare issue summaries and help develop practical options for resolving contract questions.

  • Progressively take on more responsibility as your experience and judgment develop, while escalating non-standard or higher-risk issues to qualified counsel.

Build the legal team's capabilities

  • Help create and improve templates, playbooks, legal knowledge resources and tools that allow the wider company to handle routine work more consistently.

  • Use and improve systems that make matter status, contract obligations and key deadlines visible, rather than relying on manual follow-up.

  • Work with the General Counsel, Commercial Counsel and external counsel across a varied commercial workload.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Legal training, such as a law degree, paralegal qualification or equivalent experience.

  • Some experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, commercial contracts or legal operations role is helpful. We're also open to strong early-career candidates.

  • Clear legal writing, research and issue-spotting skills, with an interest in commercial law.

  • Interest or experience in process design, automation, no-code or low-code tools, AI workflows or contract-management systems.

  • Business-standard English is required. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential.

  • Willingness to travel to the US or Paris from time to time when required.

Attitude

  • Curious and motivated to develop as a commercial legal professional.

  • Organised, careful and discreet when handling confidential information.

  • A clear communicator who is comfortable asking questions, surfacing uncertainty and taking feedback.

  • Collaborative and pragmatic, with a genuine interest in helping colleagues move work forward.

Agency

  • Proactively identifies opportunities to improve how legal work is done, then helps design and build the solution.

  • Takes ownership of process improvements from problem definition through implementation, testing and iteration.

  • Gets directly involved in commercial legal matters and follows them through within the level of responsibility agreed with supervising lawyers.

  • Uses judgment to move work forward while escalating decisions that require qualified legal review.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Lyon) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

descriptionHtml:

About fonio

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.
We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Your Role

As Partnership Account Executive, you own the British and Irish partner channel end to end. Acquisition, activation, and enablement are all yours. You bring new partners in, you get them to their first closed deal, and you give them the resources they need to sell fonio on their own. You handle the full partner base in your market, except the strategic accounts.


This is not desk based partner management. You sell alongside your partners, you sit in their customer calls, and you build the playbooks and materials that make them independent.

What you will own

  • Acquisition: You identify and screen potential partners across the UK and Ireland. You assess their real potential and decide how each one gets handled.

  • Enablement: You teach partners how to sell fonio. You build and provide the resources they need, from pitch material to objection handling, and you are their go to contact for questions.

  • Account Management: Regular check ins with your partners, unlocking upsell potential in their existing customer base, and opening new customers through and for your partners.

Your targets and KPIs

  • Revenue through partners

  • Number of activated partners (first joint deal closed)

  • Activation rate and repeat activation rate

  • Upsell rate in the existing base

Who we are looking for

  • Languages: English native is a must. German, French, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.

  • Sales background, ideally you have walked the SDR to AE path yourself. Channel or partner experience is an advantage.

  • Hands on closer mentality. You sell yourself and train partners at the same time.

  • Strong self discipline, a real sense of ownership, and genuine drive to prove yourself.

  • You are up for the Vienna start and the move to London afterwards, and you are willing to travel for partner visits and larger customer negotiations on site.

Hiring Process

  • 15 min intro

  • 45 min skill interview & case study with David

  • 20 min Deep dive with our CCO Alex

  • 20 min culture fit with both founders

How we hire?
We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.
Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet 🚀

descriptionHtml:

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We are looking for a People Operations Specialist - Regional to manage day-to-day HR operations for employees across multiple countries.

You will work across payroll, EOR and HR vendors, onboarding and offboarding, employee records, and local employment requirements. The role currently supports approximately 15-20 countries and will expand as BJAK grows into new markets.

Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore.

This is an exciting role where you will be given the opportunity to take ownership of projects and make them your own. At Akuna, we are constantly looking for ways to improve our efficiency as we continue to grow. As a Platform Engineer, you will work closely with our Trading, Development, Infrastructure, and Operations teams. You will design and implement cloud solutions, automate infrastructure as code, improve cloud governance and security, and monitor our hybrid-cloud environments. In this role, you will: 

  • Ensure cloud services are leveraged to their full potential (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and best practices are being followed
  • Help manage our public cloud growth and continuously improve Akuna’s hybrid-cloud operating model
  • Evaluate proposed solution architectures and provide recommendations
  • Provision, configure, upgrade, and monitor technologies such as Kubernetes (EKS and on-premise), Spark, Kafka, and other large-scale distributed databases
  • Automate infrastructure management and development pipelines with tools like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins and GitLab
  • Explore new technologies in the cloud-native/container ecosystem
  • Work with Infrastructure and Development teams to monitor systems, clusters and cloud deployments to detect errors and monitor performance
  • Adhere to the engineering mindset of creating and maintaining performant and reliable production systems

Qualities that make great candidates: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification preferred
  • Deep experience deploying, operating, and scaling Kubernetes in production, including on-premise clusters and Amazon EKS
  • Strong expertise designing and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS; experience with GCP is a plus
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including reusable module development, state management, and platform automation
  • Experience building and operating highly available, scalable, and secure cloud-native platforms
  • Strong knowledge of observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational troubleshooting 
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills in distributed production environments 
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting with Python, Bash, or similar languages
  • Experience with cloud-native data services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, and DynamoDB
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, and mentor engineers
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering across engineering, operations, and business teams
  • The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. title: Principal Design Engineer - Mechanical Equipment (80-100%)
descriptionHtml:
Lead technically by doing.

Join our Design Engineering team as a highly experienced individual contributor. You will take on challenging mechanical design problems yourself, from concepts and CAD models to manufacturing drawings, prototypes and tested hardware, while helping the wider team make strong technical decisions.

As a Principal Design Engineer, you are a hands-on member of our Design Engineering team, designing Climeworks’ CO2 collectors, the heart of our direct air capture plant. Improving how they perform, are manufactured and scale is central to the future success of DAC.

  • Mechanical concept & product design: You personally turn new concepts into robust physical products: developing mechanical concepts, creating CAD models, designing components and complete collector assemblies, producing manufacturing drawings, and supporting hardware through fabrication, assembly and testing.

  • Engineering problem-solving & risk reduction: Your experience helps you find the right solutions faster, anticipate problems early and reduce risk before issues reach manufacturing or testing.

  • CO2 collector design: You take mechanical systems from requirements and concepts through to detailed, manufacturable designs. You develop solutions, perform engineering calculations and make the decisions needed to create robust industrial hardware.

  • First-principles engineering: You use experience and first-principles reasoning to identify risks early, evaluate alternatives quickly and converge on simple, robust solutions. You apply calculations, tolerance analysis, design reviews and testing to reduce uncertainty.

  • Own design from concept to commercialisation: You work directly in SolidWorks to create and modify parts, assemblies and system layouts. You manage complex interfaces, packaging constraints and design changes so the complete system works together. You produce and maintain high-quality 2D manufacturing drawings, including appropriate GD&T, tolerances, materials, finishes and manufacturing requirements.

  • Prototype fabrication, assembly & testing: You stay closely involved after the CAD work is complete. You support prototype fabrication, assembly and testing, investigate issues and incorporate the learning back into the design.

  • Technical leadership & design reviews: You act as a senior technical reference for the team, supporting the Design Engineering line manager with design reviews, engineering standards and approval of critical designs. You support the extended team with technical judgement on complex mechanical design decisions, help maintain strong engineering practices and share your experience through everyday collaboration, mentoring and constructive challenge.

  • Cross-functional engineering collaboration: You work with manufacturing, testing, process engineering, procurement, suppliers and other engineering disciplines to ensure mechanical designs work as part of the complete product. You integrate external design resources where needed.


What makes you stand out

Your experience makes your engineering more effective: you spot promising solutions early, expose weak points before they become expensive, and deliver designs that are clear, manufacturable and ready to perform in the real world.

  • Mechanical Design Experience: You bring 15+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, ideally developing complex industrial equipment from concept through manufacture, assembly and testing.

  • Sheet Metal Design & Manufacturing: You have deep practical experience designing sheet-metal parts, structures and assemblies for manufacture at scale. You understand bending, welding and joining methods, forming, tolerances, material and thickness selection, and how design choices affect tooling, cost, assembly and quality.

  • CAD & Drawings: You are an expert SolidWorks user and remain hands-on with CAD. You personally create high-quality manufacturing drawings and are confident with GD&T and tolerance chains.

  • System Design & Engineering Judgement: You have experience designing from components and mechanisms through subsystems, interfaces and complex assemblies. You understand how decisions at one level affect the complete collector and can balance structures, airflow, movement, sealing, process interfaces, manufacturability, reliability and cost to arrive at robust solutions.

  • Manufacturing & DFMA: You have strong knowledge of machined parts, welded structures, materials and manufacturing processes, and apply DFMA to create robust, cost-effective designs.

  • Collaboration & Technical Leadership: You work effectively with engineers, technicians, manufacturers and suppliers. You share your experience, challenge constructively and help others make better technical decisions.

  • Education: You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar.

    This job is not for you, if…

    • you mainly want to manage people or projects.

    • you mainly do simulation, concept work or system-level engineering without your own CAD work.

    • you have no experience with sheet metal, welded structures or manufacturing at scale.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. title: Procurement Specialist
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, the AI software engineer. We’re hiring an Executive Engagement Program Manager to coordinate how our executives, Field CTOs and Managing Directors participate in our global executive programs.

You’ll start with a plan for each leader: their expertise, priority audiences and relationships, key forums and available time. You’ll turn those plans into a coordinated calendar across summits, customer advisory boards, executive sponsorship, briefings, dinners and major industry gatherings.

A strong working partnership with Sales is essential. You’ll need to understand account priorities, ask the right questions about requests and make sound recommendations about where executive involvement will be most valuable. You’ll balance those needs with our program goals and executive capacity, communicating tradeoffs clearly and pushing back constructively when needed.

This role sits within Executive Engagement and works closely with program owners, executive assistants, regional marketing, Events and Communications. You’ll bring structure and continuity to the portfolio so our leaders spend their time thoughtfully and each customer interaction builds on the last.

What you’ll do

  • Build executive engagement plans. Understand each leader’s priorities, expertise, existing relationships and capacity, then maintain a proactive plan for their participation.

  • Partner with Sales on priorities. Build trust with sales leaders and account teams. Understand which senior relationships matter, the customer’s priorities and why a particular executive or program would be valuable.

  • Manage and prioritize requests. Establish a clear intake process that captures the audience, purpose, relationship context, timing and expected value of each request. Assess requests against agreed priorities, executive fit and capacity.

  • Exercise judgment and communicate tradeoffs. Recommend what to accept, defer, redirect or decline. Offer alternatives where appropriate and route assignment decisions and escalations to the right owner.

  • Coordinate the global calendar. Align executive hosts, audiences, preparation deadlines and commitments across programs. Identify conflicts and gaps early.

  • Maintain continuity. Keep a shared record of participation, feedback and commitments. Ensure follow-up has a named owner and carries through between programs.

  • Keep the team aligned. Run planning meetings, surface decisions and report on participation, capacity and program feedback.

What you bring

  • Experience managing executive programs, executive briefings, customer advisory boards or similar programs in an enterprise environment.

  • A demonstrated ability to partner with sales, understand account priorities and translate requests into well-defined executive engagements.

  • Strong prioritization skills. You can distinguish an urgent request from a strategically important one, assess competing needs and explain your recommendations.

  • Confidence asking sales leaders and account teams for context, challenging assumptions and pushing back constructively.

  • Experience working with senior executives and their assistants, with sound judgment about how to use limited executive time.

  • Clear, concise writing and experience preparing executive briefing materials.

  • Strong organizational skills, discretion and attention to detail.

  • The ability to build practical processes and personally manage the details required to make them work.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you’ll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.

title: Project Controller (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Project Controller (m/w/d)

Einsatzort: Linden (Hessen) oder Berlin

Arbeitszeit: 40 hours/week

Bitte beachten Sie: Diese Rolle ist ausschließlich vor Ort in Berlin auszuüben

Über uns

ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten wissenschaftlicher Expertise haben wir uns als Branchenführer im Bereich der sauberen Energietechnologie etabliert.

Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten.

ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten.

Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen.

Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen

  • In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen

  • Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten

  • Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren

  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen

  • Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden

  • Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken

  • Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben

  • Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts

  • Sie empfehlen dem Projektteam alternative Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Terminplans und bringen diese zur Diskussion bzw. Entscheidungsfindung ein

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kosteningenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Kostencontrolling oder in der Projektsteuerung innerhalb der Engineering- und Bauindustrie

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Projektsteuerung im EPC-Umfeld (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie eine Zertifizierung als PMP (Project Management Professional) und/oder AACE (Certified Cost Engineer)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Softwareanwendungen zur Kostensteuerung, beispielsweise Primavera P6, MSP und SAP

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Budgetplanung, Forecasting und Abweichungsanalysen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Software, beispielsweise Power BI, SAP oder Oracle

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Kostensteuerung, insbesondere Earned Value Management (EVM)

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Sie treten als engagierter Repräsentant des Unternehmens auf, überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, den Projektfortschritt präzise und verständlich zu berichten

  • Sie sind teamorientiert und arbeiten effektiv mit anderen zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz

  • Sie arbeiten äußerst strukturiert, organisiert und eigeninitiativ

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft aus

  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Ihnen bieten

  • Sie arbeiten an einer der wichtigsten Zukunftstechnologien im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien in einem wachsenden Markt mit langfristigen Perspektiven

  • Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung

  • Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr

  • Sie erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld

  • Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen und erfahrenen Teams

  • Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung sowie gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben (in englischer Sprache)

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft des grünen Wasserstoffs mit!
