title: Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an energetic, adaptable Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations and rollouts. Though the position is remote we are looking for candidates who will cover the Kent or Scotland regions for customer visits and deployments.

In a fast-growing scale-up, project management isn't just about updating spreadsheets—it's about driving delivery pace, mitigating real-world risks, aligning cross-functional teams, and making sure our technology delivers immediate, tangible value in live operational environments.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that use some of the most advanced technologies on the market to transform rail worker safety. Our flagship geofencing solution has been named as one of TIME’s Best Inventions and has made it onto the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year.

We’re a venture-backed scale-up with an incredible team and work alongside industry-leading organisations in the rail sector to innovate and bring rail workers home safe every day. Tended is growing quickly and we're now recruiting for Project Managers to support our technology deployments on client sites around the UK.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Governance: Build and maintain detailed project plans, critical path timelines, and resource schedules using project management software (e.g., MS Project, Jira).

  • Risk & Scope Management: Continuously track risks, manage dependencies, resolve delivery blockers, and maintain scope control across parallel client deployments.

  • On-the-Ground Rollouts: Take charge of live implementations. You're comfortable being on-site in operational settings (such as depots, hubs, or shift-based operations) to support deployments—including occasional weekend, bank holiday, or overnight shifts when rollouts go live.

  • Training & User Adoption: Develop and deliver training programs tailored to different end-user cohorts—from tech-savvy site leaders to frontline operational workers—ensuring capability and long-term retention.

  • Proactive Problem Solving: Take total ownership of project issues. When deployment roadblocks appear, you take the initiative to find creative, pragmatic solutions to keep projects moving forward.

  • Client Reporting & Value Insights: Measure deployment progress and operational outcomes. Write clear, structured reports that demonstrate project performance, ROI, and key insights to client stakeholders

Requirements

About You

  • Proven PM Experience: Track record managing complex technical projects, deployments, or system rollouts end-to-end.

  • Start-Up / Scale-Up Agility: High ownership, proactive, and comfortable creating structure in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

  • Strong Leadership & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills -able to speak the language of engineers, enterprise leads, and frontline operations.

  • Full UK Driving Licence: Essential for visiting client operational sites across regions.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

  • Domain Expertise: Prior project experience in the rail, transport, logistics, or infrastructure sectors is a major advantage.

  • Academic Background: Degree or professional qualifications in Project Management (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP, APM), Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Commercial Acumen: Understanding of how project outcomes tie into client retention, expansion, and long-term account value.

title: Projektingenieur Projektsteuerung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben technische Bauprojekte im Blut, wollen aber raus aus der reinen Ausführung und rein in die Steuerung? Hier leiten Sie regionale Bahn- und Infrastrukturprojekte von der ersten Kostenschätzung bis zur Abnahme und gestalten komplexe Anlagen aktiv mit.

Sie suchen einen krisensicheren Job mit klaren Strukturen, aber ohne starre Konzernbürokratie? Sie wünschen sich ein familiäres Team, das Sie fundiert einarbeitet, und ein Gehalt zwischen 50.000 und 68.000 € je nach Erfahrung? Dann erwartet Sie hier der ideale nächste Karriereschritt.

Ihr neuer Arbeitgeber ist eine etablierte, hochspezialisierte Ingenieurgesellschaft, die zu einer namhaften Unternehmensgruppe gehört. Am Standort in Nürnberg fokussiert sich ein eingespieltes Team auf die Projektsteuerung für einen festen, extrem sicheren Großkunden aus dem Infrastrukturbereich. Hier trifft technische Expertise auf flache Hierarchien und eine partnerschaftliche Unternehmenskultur.

Projektingenieur Projektsteuerung (m/w/d) | 50.000 - 68.000 € brutto/Jahr + 30 Tage Urlaub

Das bietet der Arbeitgeber

  • Krisensicherheit & Auftragslage: Sie arbeiten exklusiv für einen bonitätsstarken Großkunden aus dem Verkehrssektor. Das garantiert Ihnen langfristig einen absolut sicheren Arbeitsplatz.

  • Fundierte Einarbeitung: Ein erfahrener Kollege begleitet Sie intensiv bei Ihren ersten Schritten. Sie lernen die komplexen Prozesse von Grund auf kennen und übernehmen erst danach eigene Projekte.

  • Regionale Baustellen: Ihre Projekte befinden sich in Bayern, weite Teile der Abstimmung finden in Nürnberg statt. Wochenlange Montagetätigkeiten entfallen, abends sind Sie zu Hause.

  • Echte Karrierechancen: Sie entwickeln sich in den nächsten Jahren zum eigenständigen Projektleiter. Die Kosten für fachliche Weiterbildungen übernimmt Ihr Arbeitgeber komplett.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub und einem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell profitieren Sie von der vollständigen Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets, Bikeleasing und einer betrieblichen Krankenzusatzversicherung.

Aufgaben

  • Sie steuern komplexe Bauprojekte an regionalen und überregionalen Verkehrsknotenpunkten von der Grundlagenermittlung bis zur finalen Übergabe.

  • Sie übernehmen das Termin- und Kostenmanagement und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Bauablauf.

  • Sie koordinieren externe Dienstleister und bewerten eingehende Angebote souverän.

  • Sie stimmen sich regelmäßig mit Behörden, wie beispielsweise dem Denkmalschutz, ab.

  • Sie begleiten die Projekte direkt vor Ort und behalten auch bei Arbeiten unter laufendem Betrieb den Überblick.

  • Sie pflegen einen engen, partnerschaftlichen Austausch mit dem Auftraggeber und allen beteiligten Stakeholdern.

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung aus dem Ausrüstungsgewerk (z. B. Elektromonteur, Geselle, Techniker, Meister)

  • Oder alternativ ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Ausrüstungstechnik oder Bauingenieurwesen

  • Sie bringen idealerweise erste fundierte Praxis auf der Baustelle mit und wissen genau, wie Bauabläufe in der Realität funktionieren. Auch motivierte Berufseinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen.

  • Deutsch (C1)

  • Ein technischer Hintergrund mit starkem Baubezug (vorzugsweise Elektrotechnik/Ausrüstungstechnik)

  • Lernbereitschaft, um sich in komplexe Regelwerke und Prozesse einzuarbeiten

  • Kommunikationsstärke für den täglichen Umgang mit Kunden und Projektpartnern

  • Bereitschaft für tagesweise Baustellenbesuche in Bayern

Bewerbung

Interessiert? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt unkompliziert bei Ihrem Ansprechpartner Benjamin Hein. Ihre Beratung durch Riverstate ist für Sie selbstverständlich kostenlos. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank gehalten: In der Regel findet nur ein einziges Gespräch direkt mit der Fachabteilung und der Geschäftsführung statt.

title: Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Rügamer & Steiner ist die führende E-Mail Marketing Agentur hinter den erfolgreichsten E-Commerce Unternehmen in DE, AU & CH.

Über 150 Online Shops vertrauen uns bereits und erreichen mit uns die Herzen & Geldbeutel ihrer Kunden.

Da immer mehr Kunden ihr Vertrauen in Rügamer & Steiner setzen suchen wir Dich als Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d).

Du bist die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Kunden und Umsetzung.

Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.

Perfekt für dich, wenn du bereits Agenturerfahrung hast und weißt, wie wichtig Tempo, Struktur und saubere Prozesse sind.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Operative Umsetzung: Eigenständige Durchführung und technische Umsetzung von Marketing-Aufgaben und Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft.
  • Daily Management & Ticketing: Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung aller eingehenden Aufgaben und Kundenanfragen.

title: Propulsion Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Propulsion Engineer - Solid Rocket Motors

We are looking for a Propulsion Engineer to support the design, development, manufacture, testing, and qualification of the solid rocket motors used on our orbital launch vehicle. This is a hands-on role covering the full motor development cycle, from preliminary design through static-fire testing and flight qualification.

 

You will work as part of the project team delivering an orbital-class launch vehicle, contributing to the development of propulsion hardware, engineering analysis, test campaigns, and the tools required to support motor and vehicle-level design.

 

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

 

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

 

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

 

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and development of solid rocket motors from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing readiness, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Perform engineering analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, motor performance, nozzle design, motor cases, and structural sizing.

  • Develop or extend Python-based analysis and simulation tools for ballistic simulation, performance prediction, structural sizing, and related design activities.

  • Translate vehicle-level performance requirements—including total impulse, burn time, thrust profile, and mass fraction—into motor-level design specifications.

  • Feed measured motor performance data back into vehicle-level design and sizing tools.

  • Support the definition and execution of verification and validation activities, including analysis, subscale and component testing, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Support the planning and execution of static-fire test campaigns, including instrumentation requirements, test preparation, and post-test data analysis.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, analysis reports, and clear records of design assumptions and results.

  • Work closely with structures, manufacturing, chemistry, systems, and vehicle engineering teams to manage interfaces and cross-disciplinary design impacts.

  • Contribute to the development of engineering methods, tools, and processes as the propulsion team and company scale.

 

What we are looking for

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Experience or demonstrated academic/project experience in solid rocket motor design, propulsion, aerospace hardware, experimental engineering, or a closely related field.

  • An understanding of several propulsion disciplines, including internal ballistics, grain design, nozzle design, motor case design, or propulsion performance.

  • A strong foundation in thermodynamics and internal ballistics, including combustion, propellant energetics, and burn-rate behaviour.

  • Working knowledge of nozzle flow theory and thrust coefficient behaviour, including off-design and altitude effects.

  • Working knowledge of pressure-vessel and composite structural design principles.

  • Proficiency in Python or a similar programming language for developing and maintaining engineering analysis tools.

  • An understanding of verification and validation approaches for propulsion hardware.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work from first principles when established methods or tools do not exist.

  • The ability to work independently, take responsibility for assigned technical work, and contribute effectively within a small, fast-moving team.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document design assumptions, analysis, and results clearly for a cross-disciplinary team.

 

Desirable experience

  • Direct experience designing, manufacturing, assembling, or testing solid rocket motors.

  • Experience with composite filament-winding process design or qualification.

  • Experience supporting or executing static-fire test campaigns.

  • Experience analysing pressure, force, temperature, or other propulsion test instrumentation data.

  • Propellant formulation or strand-burner testing experience.

  • Experience with explosives licensing, range safety, or similar regulatory processes for propellant systems.

  • Experience at an early-stage aerospace company or in a similar environment.

  • Familiarity with vehicle-level launch-vehicle design, including staging, mass budgeting, performance sizing, or trajectory analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Quantum Dot Process & Characterisation Engineer- Post-Growth Processing (Master)
descriptionHtml:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role overview

We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow.

The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted.

You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams.

Sample preparation & processing (from day one)

  • Run the established step-by-step procedure for preparing GaAs/AlGaAs samples with InAs quantum dots.
  • Carry out the cleanroom fabrication steps: chemical surface treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing.
  • Follow recipes and operating procedures precisely, and flag any deviation, drift or anomaly as soon as it appears.
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment.

Optical characterisation & validation

  • Measure QD optical properties before and after processing, using photoluminescence and white-field imaging, including at cryogenic temperature.
  • Compare pre- and post-processing results against acceptance criteria to decide whether each sample can be released to the next fabrication steps.
  • Adjust process recipes based on measurement results, within defined process windows.

Data, reporting & traceability

  • Analyse measurement data using Python and report results clearly and regularly to the Production and R&D teams.
  • Maintain the sample database so that every sample’s processing history and measurements are fully traceable.
  • Keep process documentation and procedures up to date.

Growing your scope (within the first year)

  • Contribute to the automation and optimisation of the optical measurement setups and data-acquisition pipeline.
  • Propose, design and test improvements to the fabrication steps, using experimental data and the scientific literature.
  • Take ownership of sample validation for these steps, including defining checks and acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to the development and qualification of new or additional process steps, together with the R&D team.

Requirements

Required qualifications & experience

  • Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Materials Science, Semiconductor Physics, Optics, Micro/Nanofabrication or a related field.
  • Solid foundations in semiconductor physics, particularly III-V materials.
  • Solid foundations in optics and in semiconductor fabrication processes.
  • Fluency in Python for data analysis.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature.
  • Clear documentation and communication skills.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on cleanroom experience, ideally in III-V device fabrication: wet and dry etching, PECVD deposition, thermal processing.
  • Hands-on experience with optical characterisation, including building and aligning optical setups (photoluminescence, white-field imaging).
  • Experience with cryogenic measurements (e.g. 40 K Stirling cryostat).
  • Experience automating instruments or measurement setups with Python.

You enjoy hands-on work in the cleanroom and the lab every day, and you get satisfaction from a measurement done right and a sample that is fully traceable. You are comfortable applying an established procedure with rigour, and curious enough to ask why a result looks the way it does.

Over time, you want to do more than follow the recipe: you are ready to propose ideas, make decisions based on experimental results and modify the process accordingly. You are autonomous, proactive, and enjoy working at the interface between Production and R&D.

If you are passionate about semiconductor fabrication and quantum technologies, we would love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers.

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

title: Engineering Manager – AI
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Engineering Manager – AI

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work.

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager – AI, you will lead a team building and operating the platforms customers use to train and serve AI models on our GPU infrastructure, joining one of our AI teams: MLOps Training or MLOps Inference. We hire strong managers first, then agree your team with you based on your strengths and interests.

You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Each team has around nine engineers: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer, and a platform engineer.Your first team is a starting point, and moves between teams are normal here.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test.

  • Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning.

  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it.

  • Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development.

  • A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

  • A good understanding of:

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with GPU, HPC, or AI infrastructure is a bonus. Nobody has depth in every area above: tell us which you know and which you want to learn.

What You Bring

  • People leadership: Build strong teams and help engineers grow.

  • Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail.

  • Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together.

  • Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes.

  • Curiosity: Learn new domains fast. GPUs, networks, and storage excite you rather than worry you.

  • Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (Principal Engineer and Engineering Lead) → Final.

title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
descriptionHtml:
Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)

Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

  • Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.
  • Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.
  • Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.
  • Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.
  • Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.
  • Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.
  • Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

  • Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.
  • Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.
  • Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.
  • Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.
  • Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.
  • Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you

  • Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.
  • Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.
  • Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.
  • Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and strong benefits package.
  • The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.
  • A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.
  • Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.
  • A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.
  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

title: iOS Developer
descriptionHtml:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an iOS Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an iOS Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As iOS Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimize our iOS applications using Swift, with a focus on performance, reliability and user experience.

  • Contribute to application architecture, technical design and the continued development of our modular codebase.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical solutions early.

  • Create intuitive user interfaces and experiences tailored to iOS devices.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, review code and help colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including SwiftUI, and assess how they can improve our applications.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as an iOS or mobile developer.

  • You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

  • You have experience writing unit tests and/or UI tests for mobile applications.

  • You understand object-oriented software design and architectural patterns such as MVVM.

  • You have experience with web services, cloud technologies and APIs, and are comfortable debugging issues involving memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

Ton expérience & tes compétences

· Tu as 4 à 6 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que Brand Manager ou Marketing Manager en FMCG / biens de consommation, idéalement en Food & Beverage.
· Tu as géré une ou plusieurs marques en Suisse ou en France générant un chiffre d’affaires d’au moins 30 millions CHF.
· Tu as une solide expérience dans la gestion d’un business D2C et de campagnes omnicanales (médias de masse, marketing d’influence, réseaux sociaux comme TikTok et Meta, ainsi que point de vente + pure players).
· Tu te distingues par un fort esprit opérationnel, d’excellentes compétences en gestion de projet et un fort esprit de collaboration.

Pourquoi nous ?

Chez The Quality Group, plus de 1 200 personnes partagent une mission commune : repenser la nutrition – plus saine, plus intelligente et avec une réelle valeur ajoutée pour la communauté. Nous croyons en l’esprit d’équipe, à la responsabilité individuelle et au courage de repousser les limites. Chaque contribution compte, quel que soit le site ou le service. Selon l’endroit où tu nous rejoins, différents avantages t’attendent, notamment :

Au cours du processus de recrutement, tu découvriras les avantages concrets proposés sur ton site et ce que signifie faire partie de TQG : une entreprise qui façonne l’avenir de la nutrition avec passion, qualité et courage.

The Quality Group (TQG) est un fournisseur innovant de produits de nutrition sportive qui réunit depuis 2021 les marques à succès ESN et More Nutrition. ESN est depuis 2004 le leader du marché allemand de la nutrition sportive et propose des produits tels que des protéines en poudre, des barres et des compléments alimentaires adaptés aux objectifs de fitness ambitieux. More Nutrition, fondée en 2017, est synonyme de produits nutritionnels sains et à teneur réduite en sucre, et propose des solutions pour une alimentation consciente et la gestion du poids – sans privation. Grâce à une culture d’entreprise agile et à des opportunités de carrière passionnantes, TQG est un partenaire solide non seulement pour ses clients, mais aussi pour ses collaborateurs.

title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

  

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

How fast can we grow, where should we invest, and what needs to change when performance moves off plan? As Senior FP&A Manager, you will help plancraft answer these questions as we scale across Europe.

You will build the financial view that connects our growth ambitions to what is happening in the business. Working directly with leadership, country teams, and budget owners, you will challenge assumptions, uncover what drives performance, and turn your analysis into recommendations that shape where we put our resources.

There is plenty to build along the way. You will co-own planning, forecasting, and management reporting, make Abacum a live working tool for the business, and use AI and automation to get from data to useful insights faster. Working closely with our Director of Finance and another FP&A Manager, you will have the scope to shape how FP&A operates and make it a function people turn to when they need to make a decision.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own planning and forecasting: Lead annual financial planning, budgeting, monthly forecasting, and quarterly reviews. Connect leadership’s ambitions with realistic assumptions and inputs from across the business.

  • Explain performance and recommend action: Analyse actuals against budget and forecast, investigate variances at account and cost centre level, and translate your findings into clear recommendations.

  • Build visibility across markets: Own country P&Ls and the planning and reporting structures behind them, helping stakeholders understand performance as we expand.

  • Make Abacum the place where planning happens: Own and develop our live planning model, keep it connected to reliable actuals, and make it useful for leadership and budget owners in their daily work.

  • Deliver reporting people can act on: Prepare the monthly management pack and board and investor reporting. Bring together financial performance, business drivers, and SaaS metrics such as CAC, payback, and LTV into a clear story.

  • Partner with the business: Work with budget owners on planning inputs, spending, and performance. Challenge assumptions constructively and raise risks and opportunities early.

  • Automate recurring work: Use AI and automation to improve data preparation, reporting, and planning workflows, with clear checks that keep outputs accurate and explainable.

  • Support the wider Finance agenda: Work with the Director of Finance on projects, implementations, and the financial analysis behind funding rounds. Partner with Accounting and Finance Operations on reconciliations, data quality, and audit readiness.

Your Profile

  • Exceptional communication and business partnering: You communicate clearly and confidently in English with leadership and budget owners. You make complex financial topics easy to understand, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn insights into practical recommendations. You enjoy working closely with people across the business. Communication is a significant part of this role.

  • Strong FP&A ownership: You bring extensive FP&A experience (5+ years) and have independently run planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, and can explain how your analysis informed business decisions.

  • Hands-on modelling skills: You build and maintain financial models and reports yourself, understand their underlying assumptions, and can connect operational drivers to financial outcomes.

  • SaaS, software, or tech experience: You understand the economics of a software business and can interpret the metrics that matter for its growth and performance.

  • Planning system ownership: You have owned a platform such as Abacum or a comparable planning tool, including developing models, improving workflows, and enabling stakeholders to use it.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You actively look for ways to improve recurring work and can judge where automation adds value and where human review is needed.

  • A broad Finance foundation: You understand how accounting, tax, and financial operations affect planning and reporting, and work effectively with specialists across these areas.

  • Proactive, reliable execution: You take ownership of deadlines, bring updates without being asked, and stay clear and organised when priorities compete. You are fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to board reporting or fundraising support.

  • Familiarity with Abacum, BigQuery, or connecting planning tools to accounting and operational data.

  • Another European language.

Who this role is for

You have seen what good FP&A looks like, and you are ready to build it in a business that is scaling fast. You enjoy creating the model, getting close to the business, and turning incomplete information into a recommendation people can act on.

You are comfortable taking ownership before everything is neatly defined. When inputs are missing, you bring the right people together. When assumptions do not hold up, you challenge them. When a process slows everyone down, you improve it. You can deliver the next forecast while building a better way to run the one after it.

At plancraft, that means shaping planning across growing European markets, making Abacum useful for budget owners, and putting AI and automation to work in everyday Finance. You will have room to make decisions, test better approaches, and see your work influence how we grow. That freedom comes with the expectation that you move things forward, communicate proactively, and follow through.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.
