descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control and decision support. Required Qualifications

title: Stage: Évaluation et intégration d’algorithmes de détection et suivi d’objets par deep learning (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire pour évaluer et intégrer des algorithmes de détection et de suivi d’objets basés sur le deep learning (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême.

Contexte :

Les algorithmes de détection et de suivi basés sur l’apprentissage profond évoluent vite, et leurs performances annoncées se transposent mal à de nouveaux capteurs ou de nouvelles conditions. Notre équipe développe des solutions de vision temps réel et dispose d’une bibliothèque modulaire de pipelines de traitement (C++).

Il manque une méthode fiable pour comparer les approches et choisir celles à intégrer.

Objectif :

Mettre en place une plateforme d’évaluation reproductible, puis intégrer les solutions les plus pertinentes dans la bibliothèque.

Missions :

  • Reprise de l’existant. Analyser le module actuel de détection et de suivi, diagnostiquer ses limites de généralisation sur d’autres capteurs et en rendre compte.

  • Données et protocole d’évaluation. Constituer des jeux de données infrarouges et visibles, avec découpage par séquence, tests inter-datasets et métriques normalisées (mAP, HOTA, IDF1, vitesse d’exécution).

  • Benchmark de l’état de l’art. Comparer des détecteurs et des trackers récents, avec entraînement ou fine-tuning, augmentation de données et résultats reproductibles.

  • Intégration. Intégrer les solutions retenues dans la bibliothèque C++ et réaliser des démonstrations.

  • Documentation. Rédiger un guide de décision par cas d’usage et la documentation technique.

Profil:

  • Étudiant en informatique spécialisé intelligence artificielle / vision par ordinateur / génie logiciel avec :

    • Python et PyTorch, et de bonnes bases en deep learning et en évaluation de modèles ;

    • C++ et de CMake ;

    • De la rigueur, de l’autonomie et un esprit critique argumenté.

title: Stage Social Media & Content Marketing | Flagship Events Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Social Media & Content Marketing Stagiair(e) bij Flagship Events ben je bezig met het bedenken en maken van creatieve content voor onze verschillende socialmediakanalen. Je laat zien wat Flagship Amsterdam allemaal te bieden heeft: van onze rondvaarten en evenementen tot onze verschillende activiteiten en ervaringen in de stad. Je houdt je vooral bezig met Instagram en TikTok en weet als geen ander wat er speelt op social media. Je bedenkt nieuwe concepten, gaat zelf op pad om video's te filmen en monteert deze tot aantrekkelijke content. Zo help je Flagship Events om op een creatieve en herkenbare manier zichtbaar te blijven bij verschillende doelgroepen.

Wat ga je leren?

  • Creatieve content bedenken en maken voor Instagram en TikTok;

  • Video's filmen, monteren en voorbereiden voor publicatie;

  • Een contentkalender opstellen en bijhouden;

  • Inspelen op actuele socialmediatrends en deze vertalen naar passende content;

  • Content maken rondom onze rondvaarten, evenementen en andere activiteiten;

  • Reviews en user-generated content verzamelen en verwerken;

  • De interactie met volgers onderhouden en reacties beantwoorden;

  • Meedenken over de online uitstraling en zichtbaarheid van Flagship Events;

  • Content voorbereiden en ter goedkeuring voorleggen voordat deze wordt gepubliceerd.

Praktisch

  • Startdatum: Vanaf februari 2027, of eerder in overleg;

  • Duur: 5 maanden;

  • Type stage: meewerkstage;

  • Stagevergoeding: € 350 per maand;

  • Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en op verschillende evenementenlocaties.

Wat we aanbieden

  • Een creatieve meewerkstage waarin je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen ideeën;

  • De mogelijkheid om zelf contentconcepten te bedenken, filmen en monteren;

  • De kans om jouw werk daadwerkelijk terug te zien op onze socialmediakanalen;

  • Veel ruimte om je kennis van contentmarketing en social media verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen bij verschillende merken, activiteiten en evenementen binnen Flagship;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding.

Functievereisten

  • Een opleiding in de richting van Creative Business, Communicatie of CMD;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met TikTok en Instagram, bijvoorbeeld via eigen kanalen;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig video's filmen en monteren;

  • Je hebt gevoel voor trends en weet wat werkt bij verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Een goede beheersing van het Engels;

  • Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en neemt graag initiatief;

  • Je gaat verantwoordelijk om met content en de uitstraling van een merk;

  • Ervaring met fotografie, copywriting of betaalde social media advertenties is een plus.


Over Flagship Amsterdam

Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ?

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

title: Strategic Account Executive (Eastern Europe)
descriptionHtml:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. 

We will consider applicants based in the UK or Netherlands.

You will: 

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. 
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. 
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. 
  • Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. 
  • Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. 
  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. 
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.  

You have: 

  • A demonstrable, successful track record of selling enterprise software solutions in the Eastern/Central European region
  • Proven ability to win net new business.
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. 
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. 
  • A combination of experience in selling to both public and private sector accounts is preferred.
  • Established sector-related C level contacts. 
  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. 
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. 
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. 
  • Flexibility to travel to the assigned region as required

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Strategic Account Manager - Hospitals (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Viele unserer Krankenhaus- und Klinikverbundkunden arbeiten bereits mit Doctolib. Jetzt geht es darum, gemeinsam die nächsten strategisch relevanten Chancen zu identifizieren: weitere Standorte und Teams einzubinden, neue Anwendungsfälle zu entwickeln und unsere Lösungen so einzusetzen, dass sie im Alltag wirklich helfen.

Als Strategic Account Manager Hospitals (x/f/m) arbeitest Du mit Geschäftsführungen, medizinischen Leitungen, IT und Einkauf an genau diesen Fragen. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf der Identifikation, Entwicklung und Steuerung strategisch relevanter Enterprise-Initiativen. Du entwickelst Accounts weiter und übernimmst dort die Führung, wo aus einem Potenzial eine komplexe, skalierbare Lösung für mehrere Standorte oder Häuser wird. So trägst Du täglich dazu bei, dass unsere digitalen Lösungen den Arbeitsalltag von Teams in Krankenhäusern und Kliniken verbessern.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Fokus setzen: Du arbeitest mit einer begrenzten Zahl strategischer Accounts, analysierst ihre Strukturen, Ziele und Entscheidungswege und entscheidest, wo Doctolib den größten Beitrag für unsere Kunden leisten kann.

  • Potenziale erkennen: Du identifizierst Themen, aus denen skalierbare Lösungen für mehrere Häuser oder Standorte entstehen können - etwa zentrale Rahmenverträge, große Enterprise Deals oder Vorhaben mit Relevanz für die Geschäftsführung. 

  • Mehrwert greifbar machen: Du übersetzt die Vorteile von Doctolib in Business Cases, Use Cases und kommerzielle Modelle, die zu den Zielen und Strukturen der jeweiligen Organisation passen.

  • Entscheider:innen verbinden: Du bringst Geschäftsführung, medizinische Leitung, IT und Einkauf zusammen, klärst unterschiedliche Interessen und koordinierst die passenden Doctolib-Teams. So führst Du die Beteiligten zu einer tragfähigen Entscheidung.

  • Wirkung im Blick behalten: Du steuerst Deine Pläne, Vertriebschancen, Verkaufszyklen und die Vertriebsprognose. Dabei trennst Du operative Aufgaben von Themen mit langfristigem Wert und setzt Deine Zeit dort ein, wo sie für Deine Accounts und Doctolib gleichermaßen den Beitrag leistet.

 

Dein Profil:

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Erfahrung im Key- und Enterprise Account Management: Du kannst nachweisliche Erfolge im B2B-Vertrieb in vielschichtigen Organisationen des Gesundheitswesens vorweisen – idealerweise im Software Sales (SaaS). Dadurch hast Du Erfahrung mit komplexen, strategisch relevanten Initiativen und großen Enterprise Deals. Die Komplexität hochregulierter Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Strategische Account-Entwicklung: Du erkennst skalierbare Potenziale, entwickelst belastbare Account-Pläne und priorisierst die Themen, die über mehrere Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg den größten langfristigen Business Impact erzielen.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du kennst das deutsche Gesundheitswesen aus Deiner Praxis und bist überzeugt, dass digitale Lösungen im Krankenhausalltag wirklich helfen können. Idealerweise hattest Du sogar schon mit Themen wie Digital Health oder dem Krankenhauszukunftsgesetz (KHZG) zu tun.

  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe: Du drückst Dich verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) und sicher auf Englisch (B2+) aus, kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen und  bleibst auch in komplexen Gesprächen klar und fokussiert.

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, wie wichtig der persönliche Kontakt für Deine Arbeit ist – ob mit Deinen Kund:innen oder Deinem Team. Ein Wohnort an einem unserer Office-Standorte Köln, Berlin, München oder Hamburg (oder die Bereitschaft, dorthin umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft zu Kundenterminen sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind dafür die Voraussetzungen. 

 

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients.

About Strategy & Operations at Pennylane:

At Pennylane, being part of the Strategy & Operations team means deeply understanding operational realities. As we launch our German entity, we design and implement efficient, scalable solutions that enable Pennylane to reach and exceed its ambitious expansion targets. Your role will be pivotal in structuring local operations from scratch, scaling existing processes, and tailoring our operating model to the specificities of the German market. To make this launch a success, our Strategy & Operations teams work daily alongside Business teams (Sales, Success Managers), Tech teams (Developers, Product Managers), and Data teams (Data Scientists, Data Analysts).

The Goal

Significantly boost team productivity through better tool utilization, process simplification, and operational structuring to support the launch and expansion of our German entity.

You will be the owner, key point of contact, and driver of change within the Business Teams for the German market. You will work closely with operational managers leading Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Account Management.

Your Role

Your mission will also be to ensure high customer satisfaction, hit delivery deadlines, and monitor roll-out KPIs.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an ambitious professional with a proven track record in organizational transformation, productivity improvement, project management, and operational structuring in a fast-paced environment.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Languages: Fluent in German and English

  • Minimum of 4 years of proven experience in business transformation and operational efficiency through system and tool implementation.

  • Strong natural curiosity and drive to make a real impact: active listener and sharp observer.

  • End-to-end project management experience: ability to scope problems quickly, execute fast, and iterate without waiting for perfection.

  • Ability to balance granular detail with a high-level strategic perspective.

  • Strong business acumen.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex issues.

  • Appetite for or knowledge of AI, No-Code tools, and process automation.

  • Strong analytical skills (proficiency in SQL is a plus).

  • Familiarity with SaaS business operations and tools like Salesforce and Intercom is a plus.

What do we do to make your work life easier

💵 An attractive package (detailed during the screening stage)

title: Strategy & Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:

title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLabs; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Responsible for owning the scope of Talent Operations in partnership with the Talent Operations Lead: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions.

This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

  • Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

  • Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

  • Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

  • Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

  • Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

  • Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

  • You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

  • You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

  • You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

  • You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

  • You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Technical Architect Power Platform CE
descriptionHtml:
Als Technical Architect ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de technische architectuur op de korte en lange termijn in projecten en salestrajecten. Je beschrijft en ontwikkelt de technische architectuur inclusief bijkomende integraties. Naast het ontwerpen van migratiescenario’s, onderhoud je contact met de technische en inhoudelijke stakeholders bij de klant en HSO.

Join the journey

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zet technische best practices op voor klanten en (interne) collega's. Als Technical Architect ben je de motivator voor de technische collega's van het klantteam. Als digital leader naar de klant ben je in staat om breder te kijken dan de oplossing die wij leveren en zie je deze in het totale end-to-end klantproces.

Als Technical Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technische deel van de oplossing. Daarnaast:

  • Ben je betrokken in de designfase en bepaal je welke technologieën kunnen worden gebruikt in welke scenario's;
  • Draag je bij aan de technische best practices van HSO en draag je deze ook uit naar de klant en het team;
  • Fungeer je fungeer als technische vraagbaak voor de technische en functionele consultants;
  • Houd je je bezig met integraties met andere (third-party) applicaties, denk je mee over integration patterns;
  • Zorg je ervoor dat alles in source control terecht komt en dat er automatisch uitgerold wordt d,m,v, Azure DevOps pipelines;
  • Samen met de Product Owner stel je een roadmap op voor technische verbeteringen.


Wat vertellen onze huidige technische architecten over deze rol?

“Het werk als technische architect is heel erg uitdagend en gevarieerd. Je werkt samen met hele leuke collega’s op projecten. Op het project ben je verantwoordelijk voor de algehele kwaliteit en samenhang van het IT-landschap. Primair binnen de kaders van het project. Echter doordat je implementatie altijd samenhangt met andere systemen ben je ook veel bezig met het landschap buiten het Microsoft project. Je bepaalt samen met de klant waar je naartoe gaat over de jaren heen en ziet jouw plannen dan werkelijkheid worden.

Als je het leuk vindt is er ook altijd ruimte om op de inhoud in te gaan. Als je dat doet ben je vooral bezig met de complexe onderdelen van het project en dat is erg leuk en uitdagend. Naast de projecten houd je je bezig met de best practices van HSO. Je krijgt daardoor altijd de nieuwe ontwikkelingen mee en krijgt de kans om daar wat mee te doen.”

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met Power Platform (Dynamics 365 CE, CRM) implementaties in een technische rol;
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring in programmeertaal C#;
  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden die je inzet bij het aansturen van de techneuten;
  • Je bent in staat om op basis van de behoeften van de klant een technisch ontwerp te maken en de structuur van de oplossing uit te denken;
  • Je bent in staat om de best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd hierbij leidend te laten zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten;
  • Je bent in staat de implementatie te begeleiden volgens de overeengekomen architectuur en infrastructuur;
  • Je bent inhoudelijk, analytisch, ondernemend, kwaliteitsbewust en creatief.

Wat bieden we jou?    
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; 
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   


Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO   
HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

title: Technical Program Manager - Hardware Abstraction
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

You will join the Hardware Abstraction layer of Oxa Driver: the teams that sit between our autonomy software and the vehicles it drives. They make one autonomy stack run safely on many different industrial vehicles, so their scope scales with each vehicle platform we integrate.

Hardware Abstraction is a group of teams responsible for:

  • safety-rated collision avoidance, and the evidence that supports product certification

  • vehicle and driving models that turn planned motion into commands each vehicle can execute

  • the on-vehicle safety controllers and the software that runs on them

  • the vehicle interface: the configuration and signal mapping that adapt the stack to each vehicle type

  • bringing new vehicle types into service, including retrofit drive-by-wire

The teams work closely with Integration & Test, Autonomy Applications, Vehicle Engineering, our safety team, and external hardware suppliers and vehicle manufacturers.

Your Role:

You are the delivery enabler for the Hardware Abstraction teams. You coordinate delivery so the teams can plan, build, test and ship with less friction, and their leads can focus on engineering.

You will work with engineering, product and solutions leaders across the stack who own customer outcomes. Your focus is to make sure the Hardware Abstraction layer delivers what it committed to, predictably, with its dependencies visible early.

This layer succeeds or fails on real vehicles and test rigs, so you will spend one to two

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Plans the teams can deliver: Take the layer's commitments in our product engineering plan and, with the leads, turn them into sequenced work with dates and a clear definition of done.

  • A delivery rhythm that fits: Run planning, stand-ups and retros in a format that suits each team, including the fast cadence that hardware bring-up needs. Keep Jira as the source of truth.

  • Dependencies, seen early: Track what the teams need from others and what others need from them, raise conflicts early and broker the trade-offs:

    • hardware kits, test vehicles, rigs and track time

    • supplier and vehicle-manufacturer software releases

    • handoffs to Integration & Test and Autonomy Applications

  • On-site coordination: Be the delivery presence at our vehicle sites. Get vehicle and rig time booked, and parts and people in the right place. Feed test results back into the plan.

  • Risk and change control: Keep risks visible and acted on. Make sure changes to safety-critical software and vehicle configuration follow the agreed change process, working with our safety team.

  • Reporting that saves leads' time: Report monthly progress against plan, and the health of the defect and field-issue backlog. Use simple metrics to show whether delivery is getting more predictable.

  • Better ways of working: Find the friction, such as manual steps, unclear ownership or missing test gates, and drive fixes with the teams.

    What you need to succeed:

  • A career started in engineering (a degree in electrical, mechatronic, automotive, software, robotics or similar) and have moved into delivery, with 2+ years as a TPM, project engineer or delivery manager on a technical product.

  • Knowledge of the hardware–software lifecycle: You know how work moves through requirements, supplier and ECU integration, bring-up, bench and vehicle testing, release and field support. Hands-on experience of hardware or vehicle bring-up and testing is preferred but not essential.

  • Vehicle-systems fluency: Enough to follow the engineering and ask good questions: CAN, ECUs, embedded and Linux platforms, sensors.

  • Organised and clear: You break down work, map dependencies and forecast from data (using tools like Jira, Confluence and Miro), and you build trust with engineers when priorities shift.

 

Extra kudos if you have:

  • Experience in automotive, robotics, off-highway or industrial vehicles.

  • Exposure to functional safety (ISO 13849, ISO 26262) or CE marking.

  • Experience working with hardware suppliers or vehicle OEMs, or on vehicle bring-up and commissioning.

  • Experience running agile delivery in a mixed hardware and software environment.

  • Comfort with Git-based planning, documentation-as-code, or AI tools for reporting.

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.

title: Technical Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

As a Technical Project Manager at Namespace, you'll drive technical projects from planning through execution, working closely with engineering teams to translate business goals into clear technical work, manage timelines and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned. You'll bring a strong technical background and experience working with software engineering and developer tools, allowing you to understand technical trade-offs, anticipate risks, and operate effectively alongside engineers.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll do

  • Translate high-level business goals into clear technical tasks and project plans for engineering teams

What we're looking for

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

  • Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
  • Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
  • Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
  • Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
  • Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
  • Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
  • Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
  • Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
  • Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
  • Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
  • Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

title: Transactional Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

  • Oversee & drive DSO performance improvement, setting and monitoring cash collection targets and driving corrective action where collection is behind plan by using escalation channels with various business stakeholders

  • Overseeing the review AR ledgers regularly, identifying and escalating aged debt in line with credit control policy.

  • Line-manage direct reports based in Portugal & London, while providing day-to-day supervision and quality oversight of AP, Billing and Credit Control activity across the UK, Portugal, Germany and Spain.

  • Partner with the Director of Financial Control and wider Finance team on reporting, audit requirements and process governance.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Support along with Finance Transformation the finance systems automation roadmap, driving the elimination of manual processes and delivering scalable, efficient finance operations.

  • Own the optimisation of the finance systems landscape, reviewing and enhancing NetSuite integrations with Moss, Precoro, Abacum, Salesforce and QV to ensure scalability, data integrity, and accurate revenue recognition.

  • Drive continuous improvement of finance system integrations and workflows, proactively identifying and resolving issues to enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Lead the transformation of Billing and AP processes through enhanced controls, automated workflows, invoice validation, credit management, supplier remittance optimisation, and customer communications.

  • Drive continuous improvement of transactional and billing processes, with a focus on automation and efficiency gains.

  • Supporting with Finance Transformation the rollout of a unified Source-to-Procure (S2P) solution — consolidating procurement, support ticketing, contract management, and expense reimbursement into one platform to improve control and user experience

  • Ensure alignment between NetSuite financial reporting (Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet) and Abacum planning and forecasting models to provide consistent financial insights across the business.

title: Vice President, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the role

We're hiring a Vice President to own and lead our EMEA business. You'll inherit a team of 20+ quota-carrying Commercial and Enterprise AE's across four hubs: London, Amsterdam, Munich, Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes the EMEA region from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a second-line leader role that will see you report directly to the Global Vice President of Sales and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

Hiring

  • Partner with the internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for EMEA beyond Q4 and feed into H1 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits, and customer EBCs

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Northern Europe's most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the EMEA markets back to the Global VP of Sales and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 10+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 5+ years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AE's

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across EMEA

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

Operating style

title: Werkstudent Copywriter
descriptionHtml:
In een notendop

Picnic is een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Europa. Als moderne melkboer maken we elke dag duizenden klanten blij met hun boodschappen. Dat doen we verser, goedkoper en groener dan anderen. Onze klanten doen boodschappen en plannen hun maaltijden in onze app en vervolgens bezorgen wij alles gratis thuis. Zonder omweg via de winkel, in elektrische autootjes, met een grote glimlach.
Toch is onze website minstens zo belangrijk. Het is dé plek waar we nieuwe klanten naar de app trekken. En daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig! Als Copywriter Werkstudent schrijf je heldere, wil-ik-verder-lezen-webteksten: van pagina’s die onze diensten uitleggen tot tips-en-trickspagina’s en zo nu en dan wat SEO.

De kunst van het vak

  • Webcopy: Je schrijft teksten waar je zelf op zou doorklikken. Van pagina’s over onze diensten tot recepttips en inspirerende verhalen over onze makers.
  • De juiste toon: Die weet jij wel te vinden. Want hallo, een tekst over paasrecepten vraagt om iets heel anders dan een verhaal over onze nieuwste appfunctie.
  • Samenwerken: Je spart graag met collega’s, maar gaat net zo graag zelf op onderzoek uit. Samen maken jullie onze website steeds een beetje beter. 
  • Blijven leren: Je leert van ervaren copywriters, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en ontdekt gaandeweg wat een webtekst écht goed maakt.

Over jou...

  • Je volgt een opleiding in bijvoorbeeld communicatie, journalistiek, media of creative writing.
  • Je schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en wordt blij van taal, woorden en zinnen die precies kloppen. Spreek je ook nog ein bisschen Duits? Dat is een plus!
  • Je vindt het leuk om langere teksten te schrijven en maakt complexe informatie graag behapbaar.
  • Je hebt gevoel voor structuur: je weet hoe je een tekst logisch opbouwt en online prettig leesbaar maakt.
  • Je hebt gevoel voor humor, al vind je het wat ongemakkelijk om dat over jezelf te zeggen.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen.

Picnic perks 

🥗Verse lunch, koffie en snacks

Op kantoor hebben we een koffiebar met eigen barista's, chefs die dagelijks een heerlijke, verse lunch bereiden en snacks en fruit zodat je energie op pijl blijft!

✍🏼 Learning & development 

Bij Picnic krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Werk je liever aan je mentale welzijn? Via OpenUp krijg je gratis toegang tot professionele psychologen en diverse trainingen.

💰Aantrekkelijk pakket

Je ontvangt een bruto uurloon van €16.75 (incl. vakantiegeld), samen met een laptop en telefoon om je werk te ondersteunen. Afhankelijk van je woonplaats kunnen ook je reiskosten worden vergoed.

  • Du kannst unterhalb der Woche deine Arbeitszeit flexibel auf mehrere Tage verteilen

Benefits

Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind.

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. Wer hoch hinaus möchte, bekommt früh viel Verantwortung und Entwicklungschancen, wer sich noch unsicher ist, wo es hingehen soll, wird an die Hand genommen und erhält Orientierung. title: Working Student, Launch Vehicle Structures (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief

As a Working Student in the Loads & Dynamics team, you will be at the heart of launch vehicle development. Every structural component, subsystem, and design decision ultimately depends on one fundamental question: what environments and loads will the vehicle experience during flight? 

Our team provides the engineering foundation that answers this question. By combining expertise in structural loads, dynamics, aerodynamics, thermal analysis, and fluid dynamics, we predict and characterize the complex physical environments encountered throughout all phases of flight. 

You will work directly with experienced engineers on real development activities, flight data analysis, and engineering methods used to support current and future launch vehicle programs. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with aerospace engineering challenges while contributing to safe, reliable, and independent access to space. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Flight & Test Data Analysis 
    • Support the verification and validation of loads and dynamics methodologies 
    • Develop tools and scripts for efficient data processing and comparison 
    • Compare analytical and numerical predictions against test and flight results 
    • Identify opportunities to improve models, processes, and engineering methods 
  • Post-Processing & Visualization 
    • Develop and improve automated workflows for simulation and test data evaluation 
    • Generate flow visualizations, section views, and engineering-relevant data extracts 
  • Sensors & Instrumentation 
    • Support sensor-related activities, including documentation and configuration management 
    • Perform trade studies and evaluate instrumentation solutions for flight and test campaigns 
  • Multidisciplinary Engineering Support 
    • Contribute to a broad range of Loads & Dynamics activities across the vehicle development lifecycle 
    • Gain exposure to structural loads, structural dynamics, aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, and thermal analysis 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g. Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Physics or similar)  
  • Interest in data analysis, simulation, and physical systems 
  • Programming experience with Python or Matlab 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with professional proficiency in English. 
  • Located in or near Munich, as the role requires regular on-site presence 

Bonus Skills

  • Basic knowledge of structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, or aerospace engineering 
  • Experience with CFD postprocessing tools such as ParaView, Tecplot, StarCCM+, Ansys 
  • Experience with GitLab 

Benefits

  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket or a fuel allowance
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Free snacks and drinks: Indulge in a variety of free snacks and beverages to keep you fuelled throughout the day
  • Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team. 

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

title: Workplace Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Due to the nature of this role, you will be required to work onsite in our Shoreditch office full time, Monday - Friday.

As our Workplace Coordinator, you will take broad ownership of our day-to-day office environment and supporting internal events. Working alongside a team of 4 in a highly visible role, you will be one of the first faces people see in the morning, ensuring our facilities run seamlessly while creating consistent, memorable cultural events that bring our team together.

You should apply if...

What’s in it for you?
